    6. Some people say all parents should be required to attend parenting courses. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
      Образец (Band 9), 261 слов — план, лексика, разбор
      План: Шаблон Simon «против обязательности» (как его эссе о бесплатной работе подростков). Вступление: перефраз + While I agree that…, I do not believe… (полезно, но не обязательно). Абзац 2 — On the one hand, I accept…: курсы полезны, особенно молодым родителям. Абзац 3 — On the other hand…: невозможно обеспечить исполнение, вмешательство государства; лучше — бесплатно и добровольно. Вывод.

      Some people think that every parent should have to take a course in how to bring up children. While I agree that such courses can be valuable, I do not believe that they should be compulsory.

      On the one hand, I accept that parenting classes could benefit many families. Raising a child is one of the most difficult and important jobs that anyone does, yet most people start it with no training at all. A good course could teach new parents practical skills, such as how to deal with a crying baby or how to set rules for teenagers, as well as giving them information about children's health and development. Parents who struggle with these issues, especially young parents without family support, might feel more confident and make fewer mistakes.

      On the other hand, I believe that forcing all parents to attend these courses would be both impractical and unfair. Firstly, it would be extremely difficult to enforce such a rule. It is not clear what would happen to parents who refused to attend, and punishing them would only harm their children. Secondly, many people learn to be good parents from their own families and communities, and they would resent being told by the state how to raise their children. A better approach would be to offer free, high-quality courses to anyone who wants them and to encourage those who are most likely to need help, such as first-time parents.

      In conclusion, parenting courses should be widely available, but in my opinion attending them should remain a matter of personal choice.

    7. It is important to give children the chance to act and make decisions independently. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
      Образец (Band 9), 266 слов — план, лексика, разбор
      План: Шаблон Simon «agree». Вступление: перефраз + I completely agree + уточнение (зависит от возраста). Абзац 2 — решениям учатся только на практике (пример с карманными деньгами). Абзац 3 — самостоятельность даёт уверенность и ответственность; уступка про возраст и границы. Вывод.

      Many people believe that children should be allowed to act and make decisions on their own. I completely agree with this idea, although I think that the level of independence should depend on the age of the child.

      In my opinion, making decisions is a skill that children can only learn through practice. If parents always choose their children's clothes, plan their free time and solve their problems for them, these children may grow up unable to cope with even simple choices. By contrast, a child who is allowed to decide how to spend his or her pocket money, for example, will learn about the value of money, and will also learn from mistakes. Spending all of it on sweets on the first day teaches a lesson that no lecture from a parent could teach so effectively.

      Independence also builds confidence and responsibility. When children are trusted to walk to school alone, to organise their own homework or to look after a pet, they begin to see themselves as capable people. This sense of responsibility is extremely important later in life, when they will have to make serious decisions about their studies, careers and relationships without their parents' help. Of course, the freedom given to a six-year-old should be very different from that given to a sixteen-year-old, and parents should still offer guidance and set clear limits. However, gradually increasing a child's independence is far better than protecting them from every choice.

      In conclusion, I believe that giving children opportunities to act and decide for themselves is an essential part of preparing them for adult life.

    1. If people could choose between a life without work and a life spent working most of the time, they would always choose not to work. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
      Образец (Band 9), 271 слов — план, лексика, разбор
      План: Шаблон Simon «disagree + опровержение» (как его эссе про иностранных туристов). Вступление: перефраз + I disagree, because… Абзац 2 — It is true that… (мечта о свободе, пример с лотереей), However, I would argue… Абзац 3 — работа удовлетворяет базовые потребности: смысл, общение, достижения.       Some people think that, if they had the choice, everyone would prefer a life without work to one in which they worked most of the time. I disagree with this view, because I believe that work gives people much more than just an income.

      It is true that many people dream of never having to work again. Most of us have experienced long working days, stressful deadlines or boring tasks, and the idea of unlimited free time for travel, hobbies and family can seem extremely attractive. People who win large sums in a lottery, for example, often say that the first thing they will do is leave their jobs. However, I would argue that this dream is based on a misunderstanding of what makes people happy in the long term.

      In my opinion, work meets several basic human needs that are difficult to satisfy in other ways. Firstly, it gives people a sense of purpose. Doctors, teachers and engineers can see that their efforts make a real difference to other people's lives, and even routine jobs provide a reason to get up in the morning. Secondly, the workplace is an important source of social contact. Many people meet their closest friends through work, and retired people often say that what they miss most is the company of their colleagues. Finally, work allows people to develop skills and achieve goals, which brings a feeling of pride that a life of pure leisure rarely provides.

      In conclusion, although a life without work may sound appealing, I believe that most people would soon miss the purpose, company and sense of achievement that working brings.

    2. Employers should give their staff at least four weeks' holiday a year in order to make them better at their jobs. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
      Образец (Band 9), 256 слов — план, лексика, разбор
      План: Шаблон Simon «completely agree». Вступление: перефраз + I completely agree. Абзац 2 — польза для работника: здоровье, отдых, профилактика выгорания. Абзац 3 — польза для работодателя: продуктивность, удержание сотрудников, пример Европы, новые идеи. Вывод.

      Some people believe that companies should give all employees at least four weeks of paid holiday each year so that they perform better at work. I completely agree with this view.

      In my opinion, regular holidays are essential for workers' health and well-being. People who work long hours without proper breaks are more likely to suffer from stress, exhaustion and illness. A holiday of two or three weeks gives employees the chance to rest, spend time with their families and pursue their own interests, which helps them to return to work with renewed energy. By contrast, staff who never fully recover from the pressures of their jobs may eventually experience burnout, which can force them to take long periods of sick leave or even to leave the company.

      Generous holidays also bring clear benefits for employers. Firstly, rested employees tend to be more productive and make fewer mistakes, so the time they spend away from work is often repaid by the quality of the work they do when they return. Secondly, companies that offer good working conditions find it easier to attract and keep talented staff. In many European countries, four or five weeks of holiday are standard, yet these countries remain among the most productive in the world. Finally, a holiday can give people the opportunity to travel and gain new experiences, which may lead to fresh ideas in their work.

      In conclusion, I believe that at least four weeks of annual leave benefits both employees and employers, and should therefore be a minimum requirement.

      Образец (Band 9), 270 слов — план, лексика, разбор

Абзац 3 — Despite these negatives…: инвестиции в инфраструктуру, короткая карьера спортсмена, вдохновение для детей и деньги для детских клубов. Вывод.

      It is true that professional sport has become a huge industry, and top athletes now earn enormous salaries. Although this trend has some drawbacks, I would argue that it is mainly a positive development.

      The main drawback of the commercialisation of sport is that money can sometimes become more important than the game itself. Ticket prices for major football matches have risen sharply, so many ordinary fans can no longer afford to watch their teams live. Furthermore, the salaries of the most famous players are so high that they can seem unfair when compared with the pay of nurses or teachers. In addition, some clubs are now owned by wealthy investors who seem more interested in profit than in the local communities that have supported them for generations. There is also a danger that the desire for huge rewards may tempt some athletes to cheat, for example by using performance-enhancing drugs.

      Despite these negatives, I believe that the growth of sport as a business brings more benefits. Firstly, the money from television rights and sponsorship is often invested in better stadiums, training facilities and coaching, which raises the standard of sport and makes it more exciting to watch. Secondly, professional careers in sport are short and risky, and high earnings give athletes financial security after they retire, often in their early thirties. Finally, the success of famous sportspeople inspires millions of children to take up sport, and some of the profits are used to fund grassroots clubs and community programmes.

      In conclusion, while I recognise the possible disadvantages of commercial sport, I consider it to be a positive development overall.

    4. Working for a multinational company is the best way to understand other cultures. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
      Образец (Band 9), 279 слов — план, лексика, разбор
      План: Шаблон Simon «partly agree». Вступление: перефраз + While I agree that…, I do not think… (полезно, но не лучший способ). Абзац 2 — On the one hand, I accept…: международные команды, командировки, пример инженера. Абзац 3 — On the other hand, I believe…: у бизнеса своя «международная» культура; жить с местными и учить язык эффективнее. Вывод.

      Some people believe that working for an international company is the most effective way to learn about other cultures. While I agree that this kind of job can broaden people's understanding of the world, I do not think that it is the best way to do so.

      On the one hand, I accept that multinational companies offer valuable opportunities for cultural learning. Employees often work in teams with colleagues from many different countries, and they have to communicate, negotiate and solve problems together. For example, an engineer from Brazil working on a project with partners in Japan will quickly learn about Japanese attitudes to punctuality and decision-making. Some staff are also sent on business trips or transferred to overseas offices, which gives them first-hand experience of life in another country.

      On the other hand, I believe that there are better ways to understand a culture deeply. The main limitation of working for a global company is that the business world has its own international culture. Meetings are usually held in English, offices around the world look very similar, and people tend to behave in a professional rather than a natural way. By contrast, someone who lives with a local family, studies abroad or travels independently is more likely to experience the everyday life, food, humour and traditions of a country. Learning the local language is perhaps the most important step of all, because it allows people to talk to ordinary citizens rather than only to business contacts.

      In conclusion, working for a multinational company can teach employees a certain amount about other cultures, but in my opinion living among local people and learning their language are far more effective.

    5. Advertisements, whether amusing or annoying, do not really influence what people buy. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
      Образец (Band 9), 252 слов — план, лексика, разбор
      План: Шаблон Simon «completely disagree». Вступление: перефраз + I completely disagree. Абзац 2 — доказательство: компании тратят миллиарды и измеряют результат; таргетированная реклама. Абзац 3 — реклама действует, даже когда мы её игнорируем: узнаваемость бренда, навязчивые слоганы, формирование «потребностей». Вывод.

      Some people claim that advertising, whether it is entertaining or irritating, has little effect on people's buying decisions. I completely disagree with this view.

      In my opinion, the fact that companies spend enormous sums on advertising is strong evidence that it works. Global brands such as Coca-Cola and Nike invest billions of dollars every year in television commercials, online campaigns and sponsorship deals. These companies carefully measure the results of their marketing, and they would not continue to spend so much money if advertising had no effect on sales. Furthermore, social media platforms earn most of their income from targeted adverts, which are designed to appear in front of exactly the people who are most likely to buy a particular product.

      I would also argue that advertising influences us even when we believe that we are ignoring it. An amusing advert may not persuade us to buy something immediately, but it makes us remember the brand. Later, when we are standing in a supermarket choosing between two similar products, we are likely to pick the one that seems familiar. Even annoying adverts can have this effect, because a slogan or a song that is repeated many times stays in our minds. In addition, adverts shape our ideas about what we need in order to be happy, attractive or successful, and this can encourage people to buy things that they do not really need.

      In conclusion, I believe that advertisements have a powerful influence on consumers, whether they find them amusing or annoying.

    Environment & transport

    1. Some cities have vehicle-free days, when private cars are banned from the centre. Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?
      Образец (Band 9), 263 слов — план, лексика, разбор
      План: Шаблон Simon «advantages outweigh». Вступление: факт + Although…, I believe that its advantages clearly outweigh… Абзац 2 — On the one hand, I accept… (минусы: жители, пожилые, бизнес, доставка). Абзац 3 — However, I would argue that these problems are relatively minor…: чистый воздух, привычка к транспорту, пример Парижа, исключения снимают минусы. Вывод.

      In some cities, private cars are banned from the centre on certain days. Although this policy causes some problems, I believe that its advantages clearly outweigh its disadvantages.

      On the one hand, I accept that car-free days can be inconvenient for some people. Residents who live in the city centre may find it difficult to carry heavy shopping home or to visit relatives elsewhere. Elderly and disabled people, who may depend on cars, could find it harder to get around. Businesses such as restaurants and shops might also lose customers who usually drive into the centre, and delivery companies may have to change their routes and schedules. For people who have no alternative to driving, such as tradespeople carrying heavy tools, a car-free day can mean a day without work.

      However, I would argue that these problems are relatively minor compared with the benefits. Firstly, banning cars even for one day significantly reduces air pollution and noise, which improves the health and quality of life of everyone in the area. Secondly, car-free days encourage people to try public transport, cycling and walking, and some of them may continue to use these forms of transport afterwards. In Paris, for example, car-free events have been extremely popular, and streets that are normally full of traffic become spaces for families, cyclists and street performers. Finally, the inconvenience can be reduced by allowing exceptions for emergency vehicles, disabled drivers and deliveries at certain times.

      In conclusion, while vehicle-free days cause some difficulties, I believe that the benefits for public health and city life are far more significant.

    2. Some people think governments should be responsible for reducing pollution from transport, while others think individuals should be. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
      Образец (Band 9), 256 слов — план, лексика, разбор
      План: Шаблон Simon «discuss both views». Вступление: People have different views about… + своя позиция (главная роль — у государства). Абзац 2 — On the one hand, there are some reasons why people argue…: личный выбор важен и меняет спрос. Абзац 3 — On the other hand, I would argue…: выбор возможен, только если есть инфраструктура; законы, стимулы, плата за въезд (Лондон). Вывод.

      People have different views about who should take responsibility for reducing the pollution caused by transport. While individuals can certainly play a part, I believe that governments have the most important role.

      On the one hand, there are some reasons why people argue that individuals should take action. Every car journey adds to the problem, so personal choices clearly matter. People can decide to walk or cycle for short journeys, share cars with colleagues, use public transport, or buy an electric or more fuel-efficient vehicle. Furthermore, if large numbers of people change their habits, companies and politicians will notice the demand for cleaner products and services. In this sense, individual behaviour can drive wider change.

      On the other hand, I would argue that governments are in a much stronger position to tackle transport pollution. Individuals can only make greener choices if those choices are realistic and affordable. For example, people will not leave their cars at home unless there is a reliable and reasonably priced public transport system, and building such a system requires government investment. Governments can also introduce laws that limit vehicle emissions, offer financial incentives for electric cars, and impose charges on drivers who enter city centres, as London has done with its congestion charge. These measures affect millions of people at once, which makes them far more powerful than the efforts of individuals.

      In conclusion, individuals should do what they can to reduce pollution, but in my opinion governments must take the lead by creating the conditions that make clean transport possible.

    3. A great deal of food is wasted around the world. Why does this happen? How can the problem be solved?
      Образец (Band 9), 281 слов — план, лексика, разбор
      План: Шаблон Simon «причины + решения» (как его эссе про окружающую среду). Вступление: факт + ответ на оба вопроса. Абзац 2 — There are various reasons why…: супермаркеты и сроки годности, лишние покупки по акциям, потери из-за хранения в бедных странах. Абзац 3 — However, there are several measures that could…: законы (Франция), «некрасивые» овощи, обучение покупателей, инвестиции в хранение. Вывод.

      It is true that huge quantities of food are thrown away every day around the world. There are several reasons for this problem, but I believe that governments, businesses and individuals could all take steps to reduce it.

      There are various reasons why so much food is wasted. Firstly, supermarkets often reject fruit and vegetables that are the wrong shape or size, even though they are perfectly safe to eat, and they throw away products as soon as they pass their 'best before' dates. Secondly, many consumers buy more food than they need. Special offers such as 'buy one, get one free' encourage people to fill their shopping trolleys, and a large proportion of this food goes off before it can be eaten. Finally, in poorer countries, a lot of food is lost before it reaches the shops, because farmers lack proper storage facilities and refrigerated transport.

      However, there are several measures that could help to solve this problem. Governments could pass laws that require supermarkets to donate unsold food to charities, as France has done, instead of sending it to landfill. Retailers could also sell 'ugly' vegetables at lower prices and stop offering deals that encourage people to overbuy. At the same time, public campaigns could teach consumers to plan their meals, write shopping lists and understand the difference between 'best before' and 'use by' dates. In developing countries, investment in storage and transport would ensure that more of the harvest reaches the people who need it.

      In conclusion, food waste is caused by the practices of both retailers and consumers, as well as by poor infrastructure, but a combination of laws, business changes and education could greatly reduce it.

    4. Some people believe it is impossible to be a responsible tourist who respects the local culture and environment. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
      Образец (Band 9), 260 слов — план, лексика, разбор
      План: Шаблон Simon «disagree + уступка». Вступление: перефраз + I disagree, because… Абзац 2 — It is true that…: туризм вредит (рифы, перелёты, неуважительное поведение). Абзац 3 — However, I would argue…: путешественник многое контролирует — обычаи и одежда, местный бизнес, поезд и охраняемые зоны; личный опыт. Вывод.

      Some people argue that tourists can never truly respect the culture and environment of the places they visit. I disagree with this view, because I believe that responsible travel is possible if visitors make the effort.

      It is true that tourism often causes damage. Large numbers of visitors can put pressure on fragile environments, such as coral reefs and mountain paths, and the flights that take them abroad produce significant carbon emissions. Some tourists also behave disrespectfully, for example by wearing inappropriate clothing in religious buildings or by treating local people as attractions to be photographed. It is easy to see why some people believe that the very presence of tourists is harmful.

      However, I would argue that individual travellers have a great deal of control over the impact they have. Firstly, they can learn about local customs before they travel, dress appropriately, and learn a few words of the local language, which shows respect and is usually appreciated. Secondly, they can choose locally owned hotels, restaurants and guides, so that their money supports the community rather than international companies. Thirdly, they can reduce their environmental impact by travelling by train where possible, staying longer in one place rather than taking several short trips, and following the rules in protected areas. In my own experience, local people are often delighted to share their culture with visitors who show genuine interest and respect.

      In conclusion, although tourism can cause harm, I believe that it is entirely possible to be a responsible tourist who respects both local cultures and the natural environment.

    5. Organised tours to remote places and communities are increasingly popular. Is this a positive or negative development for the local people and the environment?
      Образец (Band 9), 259 слов — план, лексика, разбор
      План: Шаблон Simon «positive or negative» с перевесом минусов. Вступление: факт + Although…, I believe… mainly negative. Абзац 2 — The main benefit of…: доход и сохранение традиций. Абзац 3 — However, I would argue that the drawbacks are more serious: хрупкая природа, быстрая смена образа жизни, деньги уходят туркомпаниям. Вывод.

      It is true that tours to remote areas and isolated communities have become increasingly popular. Although these trips can bring some benefits, I believe that they are mainly a negative development for local people and the environment.

      The main benefit of this kind of tourism is economic. Remote communities often have very few sources of income, and visitors who pay for guides, accommodation, food and handmade crafts can provide much-needed money. In some cases, this income helps to pay for schools, clinics and better roads. Tourism can also give local people a reason to preserve their traditions, such as music, dance and crafts, because visitors are interested in them.

      However, I would argue that the drawbacks are more serious. Firstly, remote environments are often fragile, and even small groups of tourists can cause lasting damage. Vehicles erode tracks, rubbish is left behind, and wildlife may be disturbed by noise and crowds. Secondly, the arrival of tourists can change the way of life of small communities very quickly. Traditional ceremonies may be turned into performances for visitors, and young people may abandon farming to work in tourism, which leaves the community dependent on an unreliable source of income. Finally, much of the money from organised tours goes to travel companies based in cities or abroad rather than to local people, who may receive only low wages as porters, drivers or cleaners.

      In conclusion, while tours to remote places can provide some income for isolated communities, I believe that their negative effects on traditional cultures and fragile environments are more significant.

    6. Some people think animals may be used in any way that benefits humans; others think this is wrong. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
      Образец (Band 9), 272 слов — план, лексика, разбор
      План: Шаблон Simon «discuss both views» (как его эссе про эксперименты на животных). Вступление: People have different views about… + своя позиция (только без лишних страданий). Абзац 2 — On the one hand, there are several reasons why some people believe…: еда, транспорт, медицина, «человек важнее». Абзац 3 — On the other hand, I agree with those who argue…: животные чувствуют боль; примеры неоправданного использования; критерий: польза значительна и условия хорошие. Вывод.

      People have different views about the extent to which humans have the right to use animals for their own benefit. While some believe that any use is acceptable, I think that we should only use animals in ways that do not cause unnecessary suffering.

      On the one hand, there are several reasons why some people believe that humans may use animals however they wish. Throughout history, animals have provided people with food, clothing and transport, and they still play an essential role in farming in many parts of the world. Supporters of this view also point out that medical research on animals has led to vaccines and treatments that have saved millions of human lives. In their opinion, human needs must always come first, and animals do not have the same moral status as people.

      On the other hand, I agree with those who argue that we cannot use animals in any way we like. Animals are capable of feeling pain and fear, and I believe that we have a responsibility to treat them humanely. Some uses of animals bring only minor benefits to humans while causing great suffering. For example, keeping chickens in tiny cages simply to produce cheaper eggs, or forcing wild animals such as elephants and bears to perform tricks for tourists, cannot be justified. In my view, using animals is acceptable only when the benefit is significant and the animals are well treated, as on farms with high welfare standards.

      In conclusion, although animals are useful to humans in many ways, I believe that this does not give us the right to exploit them without considering their welfare.

    Society, culture & technology

    1. Some people think that anyone can create art, while others believe it requires special talent. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
      Образец (Band 9), 265 слов — план, лексика, разбор
      План: Шаблон Simon «discuss both views», средняя позиция. Вступление: People have different views about… + позиция (творить может каждый, великое искусство требует таланта). Абзац 2 — On the one hand…: дети творят сами, понятие искусства расширилось, доступные инструменты. Абзац 3 — On the other hand, I agree with those who argue…: исключительные способности (Моцарт), но одного таланта мало. Вывод.

      People have different views about whether artistic ability is something that everyone has or a special gift that only a few people possess. In my opinion, anyone can create art, but producing great art requires talent as well as hard work.

      On the one hand, there are several reasons why some people believe that art is open to everyone. Children all over the world draw, sing and make up stories without being taught, which suggests that creativity is a natural part of being human. Furthermore, the definition of art has become much broader in modern times. Photography, graffiti, digital design and even cooking can be regarded as forms of art, and many of these require more imagination than technical skill. With the help of online tutorials and affordable equipment, almost anyone can now take beautiful photographs or record their own music.

      On the other hand, I agree with those who argue that outstanding art requires special talent. It is clear that some individuals, such as Mozart, who wrote music as a young child, are born with exceptional abilities that cannot be explained by practice alone. Most people could learn to paint a pleasant landscape, but very few could produce a work that moves people centuries later. At the same time, talent alone is rarely enough. Even the greatest artists spent years developing their technique, and many talented people never achieve anything because they lack the determination to practise.

      In conclusion, I believe that creating art is open to everyone, but a combination of natural talent and dedication is needed to create work of lasting value.

    2. Some people think governments should fund artists such as painters and musicians; others think this is a waste of public money. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
      Образец (Band 9), 277 слов — план, лексика, разбор
      План: Шаблон Simon «discuss both views». Вступление: People disagree about… + Although I understand…, I believe… (ограниченная поддержка оправдана). Абзац 2 — On the one hand…: бюджеты ограничены, важнее больницы и школы; искусство должно окупаться само. Абзац 3 — On the other hand, I believe…: оркестры и театры не выживут без поддержки; экономическая отдача (туризм, рабочие места); гранты для талантов из бедных семей. Вывод.

      People disagree about whether public money should be spent on supporting painters, musicians and other artists. Although I understand why some people see this as a waste of money, I believe that a limited amount of government funding for the arts is justified.

      On the one hand, there are several reasons why people object to state support for artists. The main argument is that governments have limited budgets, and money spent on the arts cannot be spent on hospitals, schools or public transport. Many taxpayers feel that these essential services should always come first, especially when they are underfunded. Opponents also argue that successful art should be able to pay for itself. If people value a particular painter or band, they will buy their work or tickets to their concerts, so there is no need for the state to intervene.

      On the other hand, I believe that some forms of art would not survive without public support. Orchestras, opera companies and theatres have very high costs, and ticket prices alone cannot cover them unless they are made too expensive for ordinary people. Government funding helps to keep these performances affordable and allows schools to take children to see them. Furthermore, the arts bring economic benefits that are not always obvious. Festivals, galleries and concerts attract tourists, create jobs and make cities more attractive places to live, so the money invested in them often comes back to the economy. Finally, public grants give talented young artists from poor backgrounds a chance to develop.

      In conclusion, while essential services must remain the priority, I believe that a modest amount of public money for the arts is a worthwhile investment.

    3. Live performances such as theatre and concerts are no longer necessary because people can watch them on television or online. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
      Образец (Band 9), 262 слов — план, лексика, разбор
      План: Шаблон Simon «completely disagree». Вступление: перефраз + I completely disagree. Абзац 2 — живой опыт нельзя заменить экраном: общая атмосфера, каждый концерт разный, отвлечения дома. Абзац 3 — экономика и культура: концерты кормят музыкантов (стриминг платит мало), площадки растят новых артистов. Вывод.

      Some people argue that there is no longer any need for live theatre and concerts, because performances can be watched on television or online. I completely disagree with this view.

      In my opinion, watching a performance on a screen is a very different experience from seeing it live. When people attend a concert or a play, they share the moment with hundreds or even thousands of other people, and the excitement of the audience becomes part of the event. Performers also respond to the atmosphere in the room, so every live show is slightly different. By contrast, a recording on a laptop or a phone is often watched alone and with constant distractions, such as messages and notifications. It is difficult to feel the same emotional connection with a performance when it is reduced to a small rectangle on a screen.

      Live performances are also important for economic and cultural reasons. For many musicians, concert tours are now the main source of income, because online streaming services pay them very little for their recordings. If people stopped going to live events, many artists would be unable to make a living, and the quality and variety of the music and drama available on screens would eventually decline. Furthermore, local theatres and music venues provide opportunities for new performers to develop their skills in front of real audiences, which is how most famous actors and musicians began their careers.

      In conclusion, I believe that live performances remain necessary, both for the unique experience they offer audiences and for the survival of the performing arts.

    4. More and more knowledge is stored on the internet instead of in books. Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?
      Образец (Band 9), 257 слов — план, лексика, разбор
      План: Шаблон Simon «advantages outweigh». Вступление: факт + Although…, I believe that the advantages are far greater. Абзац 2 — On the one hand, there are some drawbacks…: ненадёжные источники, информация исчезает. Абзац 3 — However, I would argue that these disadvantages are outweighed by the benefits: доступ для всех, обновление и поиск, решение проблемы надёжности. Вывод.

      It is true that more and more information is now stored online rather than in printed books. Although this trend has some disadvantages, I believe that the advantages are far greater.

      On the one hand, there are some drawbacks to relying on the internet for knowledge. Firstly, much of the information online has not been checked by experts, and it can be difficult to distinguish reliable sources from inaccurate or deliberately misleading ones. Printed books, by contrast, usually go through a careful editing process. Secondly, digital information can disappear. Websites are deleted, companies go out of business, and file formats become out of date, whereas a book on a library shelf can survive for centuries.

      However, I would argue that these disadvantages are outweighed by the benefits. The most important advantage is access. Anyone with a smartphone can now read encyclopaedias, academic articles and online courses that would once have been available only in large libraries. A student in a small village can therefore learn as much as one in a capital city, as long as he or she has an internet connection. Furthermore, online information can be updated immediately, which is essential in fast-changing fields such as medicine and technology, and it can be searched in seconds. Finally, storing knowledge digitally saves paper and space, and the problem of reliability can be reduced by teaching people how to evaluate sources.

      In conclusion, while online knowledge is not always reliable or permanent, I believe that the benefits of easy access and up-to-date information clearly outweigh these drawbacks.

    5. The number of crimes committed by young people is rising in many countries. Why is this? How should young offenders be dealt with?
      Образец (Band 9), 291 слов — план, лексика, разбор
      План: Шаблон Simon «причины + решения» (как его эссе про бывших заключённых). Вступление: факт + ответ на оба вопроса (реабилитация, а не жёсткое наказание). Абзац 2 — There are various reasons why…: семья, нет возможностей, соцсети. Абзац 3 — In my view, the best way…: тюрьма ухудшает; общественные работы, наставники, обучение; тюрьма только для тяжких преступлений. Вывод.

      It is true that crimes committed by young people have become more common in many parts of the world. There are several possible reasons for this, and in my opinion young offenders should be dealt with through education and rehabilitation rather than harsh punishment.

      There are various reasons why some teenagers turn to crime. Firstly, many young offenders come from difficult family backgrounds. Children who grow up with little parental supervision, or who experience poverty and violence at home, may look for a sense of belonging in street gangs. Secondly, a lack of opportunities can play a part. In areas with high unemployment and few youth facilities, bored teenagers may become involved in vandalism, theft or drug dealing. Finally, social media can make crime seem glamorous, and some young people commit offences simply to impress their friends or to gain attention online.

      In my view, the best way to deal with young offenders is to help them change their behaviour. Sending teenagers to prison often makes the problem worse, because they mix with more experienced criminals and find it harder to get a job after they are released. Instead, courts could require young offenders to do community service, such as cleaning parks or helping in care homes, which shows them the effects of their actions on others. Mentoring schemes, in which young people are supported by trained adults or reformed offenders, can also be effective, as can education and training programmes that give them the skills to find work. Prison should be reserved for the most serious and violent crimes.

      In conclusion, youth crime is often linked to family problems, a lack of opportunities and social pressure, and I believe that rehabilitation is more effective than punishment in dealing with it.

    6. Online gambling apps should be banned rather than made freely available. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
      Образец (Band 9), 255 слов — план, лексика, разбор
      План: Шаблон Simon «completely agree». Вступление: перефраз + I completely agree. Абзац 2 — приложения опаснее традиционных азартных игр: доступны всегда, созданы вызывать зависимость; последствия. Абзац 3 — особый вред для молодёжи + опровержение возражения (It could be argued that… However…). Вывод.

      Some people believe that online gambling apps should be banned instead of being freely available. I completely agree with this view.

      In my opinion, gambling apps are far more dangerous than traditional forms of gambling. In the past, people who wanted to bet had to visit a betting shop or a casino, which limited how often they could gamble. Today, by contrast, gambling apps are available on a smartphone twenty-four hours a day. They are designed to be addictive, with bright colours, sound effects, frequent small wins and constant notifications that encourage users to keep playing. As a result, it is extremely easy for people to lose control, and some users lose their savings, fall into serious debt and even lose their homes or families.

      Furthermore, gambling apps are particularly harmful to young people. Although most countries have age limits, these are difficult to enforce online, and teenagers can often use a parent's account or bank card. Many video games now include features that are very similar to gambling, which makes betting seem normal and harmless from an early age, long before young people understand the risks. It could be argued that a ban would simply push gamblers towards illegal websites. However, I believe that removing gambling apps from official app stores and blocking payments to gambling companies would greatly reduce the number of people who are exposed to this risk.

      In conclusion, because online gambling apps are so accessible and addictive, I believe that governments should ban them in order to protect vulnerable people.

      Разбор: Контраргумент (запрет толкнёт людей к нелегальным сайтам) не вынесен в отдельный абзац, а назван и опровергнут в двух предложениях. Это ровно то, что Simon советует для «completely agree»: упомянуть другую сторону можно, но только чтобы показать, почему она неверна. Абзацы начинаются с In my opinion и Furthermore, так что видно, что оба поддерживают одну позицию.

    Task 2 — темы из Cambridge IELTS 19 и 20

    Темы пересказаны; точные формулировки — в самих книгах.

    1. Cambridge 20, Test 1. Access to clean water is a basic human right, so every home should have a water supply provided free of charge. Agree / disagree.
      Образец (Band 9), 274 слов — план, лексика, разбор
      План: Шаблон Simon «partly agree». Вступление: перефраз + While I agree that…, I do not believe… (доступ — да, полностью бесплатно — нет). Абзац 2 — On the one hand, I accept…: вода жизненно необходима; бедные семьи и девочки, которые носят воду. Абзац 3 — On the other hand, I believe…: инфраструктура стоит денег; бесплатное расходуют зря; справедливая система — базовый объём бесплатно. Вывод.

      Some people argue that, since clean water is a basic human right, every household should receive it free of charge. While I agree that everyone should have access to safe water, I do not believe that it should be completely free.

      On the one hand, I accept that water is different from most other products. Nobody can survive without it, and a lack of clean water causes serious diseases, especially among children. In many parts of the world, poor families spend a large part of their income on water, or women and girls spend hours each day collecting it instead of working or going to school. For these reasons, it is right that governments should guarantee every home a supply of safe drinking water, whatever the family's income.

      On the other hand, I believe that making water entirely free would cause serious problems. Firstly, supplying clean water is expensive. Reservoirs, treatment plants and pipes must be built and maintained, and if consumers paid nothing, this money would have to come from taxes or would simply not be available. Secondly, people tend to waste resources that cost nothing. If water were free, some households might fill swimming pools or water large gardens without thinking, which is a serious concern in countries that already suffer from drought. A fairer system would be to provide a basic amount of water for drinking, cooking and washing free of charge, and to charge for any use above this level.

      In conclusion, access to clean water is a right that governments must protect, but I believe that charging for heavy use is necessary to fund the system and prevent waste.

      Разбор: Вопрос соединяет две идеи: «вода — право» и «значит, бесплатно для всех». Автор соглашается с первой и предлагает компромисс по второй. Компромисс (A fairer system would be to…) придаёт ответу практичность, и Simon часто заканчивает основной абзац именно таким решением.
    2. Cambridge 20, Test 2. In many countries school children have summer holidays of two months or more. What is the value of long holidays? What are the arguments for making them shorter? Two-part question.
      Образец (Band 9), 261 слов — план, лексика, разбор
      План: Шаблон Simon «two questions». Вступление: факт + ответ на оба вопроса (есть польза, но есть и сильные доводы за сокращение). Абзац 2 — ценность длинных каникул: отдых, опыт вне школы, отдых учителей. Абзац 3 — доводы за сокращение: «летняя потеря знаний», особенно у бедных; проблемы работающих родителей; решение — распределить каникулы. Вывод.

      In many countries, schoolchildren have a summer break of two months or longer. Although these long holidays have some real benefits, there are also strong arguments for reducing them.

      Long summer holidays are valuable in several ways. Firstly, they give children a proper rest after a demanding school year. Pupils who have spent months studying for tests need time to relax, play and recover their energy. Secondly, a long break gives children the chance to have experiences that school cannot provide. They can go to summer camps, travel with their families, learn to swim or spend time with grandparents in the countryside. These activities help them to become more independent and to develop interests outside the classroom. Teachers also benefit, because they can rest and prepare for the next academic year.

      However, there are good reasons to make summer holidays shorter. The main argument is that children forget a great deal of what they have learned during a long break, and teachers often have to spend the first weeks of the new year revising old material. This 'summer learning loss' is usually worse for children from poorer families, who cannot afford educational trips or private lessons. Long holidays also create difficulties for working parents, who rarely have more than four weeks of leave and must pay for childcare for the remaining time. Spreading the holidays more evenly across the year, with a shorter summer break, could solve both problems.

      In conclusion, long summer holidays give children rest and valuable experiences, but shorter breaks would reduce learning loss and help working families.

      Разбор: В вопросе нет «agree/disagree», поэтому личное мнение не обязательно, и Simon в таких случаях просто отвечает на каждый вопрос в своём абзаце. Абзацы начинаются с прямого ответа (Long summer holidays are valuable… / However, there are good reasons…), а вывод кратко повторяет оба ответа.
    3. Cambridge 20, Test 3. Some people have decided to fly less or stop flying altogether for environmental reasons. Do the environmental benefits outweigh the disadvantages for individuals and businesses? Opinion.
      Образец (Band 9), 276 слов — план, лексика, разбор
      План: Шаблон Simon «advantages outweigh» (польза для экологии важнее). Вступление: факт + Although…, I believe… Абзац 2 — On the one hand, I accept…: неудобства для людей (поездки, родственники) и бизнеса (встречи, доходы). Абзац 3 — However, I would argue…: масштаб выбросов авиации; многие издержки меньше, чем кажется (видеосвязь, поезд). Вывод.

      It is true that some people have chosen to reduce the number of flights they take, or to stop flying altogether, because of the damage that air travel does to the environment. Although this decision has some drawbacks for individuals and companies, I believe that the environmental benefits are more important.

      On the one hand, I accept that flying less can be costly and inconvenient. For individuals, it may mean fewer holidays abroad, longer journeys by train or coach, and less frequent visits to friends and relatives who live in other countries. For businesses, face-to-face meetings with international clients can be valuable, and replacing them with video calls may make it harder to build trust and win contracts. The tourism and aviation industries could also lose revenue, which might lead to job losses.

      However, I would argue that these disadvantages are outweighed by the benefits. Aviation is one of the fastest-growing sources of greenhouse gas emissions, and a single return flight between Europe and Asia can produce more carbon dioxide than some people produce in a whole year. If more people fly less, the effect on the climate could be significant. Furthermore, many of the costs are smaller than they first appear. Video conferencing has improved enormously, and many companies found during the pandemic that they could work effectively without frequent business trips, saving both time and money. Train travel can also be comfortable and enjoyable, and it allows people to work or relax during the journey.

      In conclusion, flying less does have some negative consequences, but I believe that protecting the climate is far more important, and that most of these disadvantages can be managed.

      Разбор: Вопрос требует рассмотреть недостатки и для людей, и для бизнеса, и абзац 2 честно разбирает обе группы (For individuals… / For businesses…). Абзац 3 не просто перечисляет плюсы, а показывает, что минусы меньше, чем кажутся (smaller than they first appear), и это прямой ответ на вопрос «outweigh?».
    4. Cambridge 20, Test 4. The clothes people wear are increasingly influenced by global trends. How has this changed the way people dress? Is it a positive or negative development? Two-part question.
      Образец (Band 9), 255 слов — план, лексика, разбор
      План: Шаблон Simon «two questions» с оценкой. Вступление: факт + короткий ответ на оба вопроса (одежда стала одинаковой, в целом негативно). Абзац 2 — как изменилось: одинаковые стили и бренды; мода меняется быстро, одежду выбрасывают. Абзац 3 — In my view…: уступка (больше выбора), но fast fashion вредит природе и местным традициям. Вывод.

      It is true that the clothes people wear are now strongly influenced by international fashion trends. This has made the way people dress around the world much more similar, and in my opinion it is a largely negative development.

      Global trends have changed people's clothing in several ways. Firstly, people in different countries increasingly wear the same styles and brands. Jeans, trainers and T-shirts can be seen on the streets of Tokyo, Lagos and Mexico City, and traditional clothing is often worn only for weddings and festivals. Secondly, fashion now changes much faster than in the past. Social media influencers and celebrities promote new looks every week, and international chains copy these styles within a few weeks and sell them at very low prices. As a result, many young people buy clothes frequently and throw them away after wearing them only a few times.

      In my view, these changes do more harm than good. It is true that global fashion gives people more choice and allows them to express themselves through their clothes. However, the rise of cheap 'fast fashion' has serious environmental costs. The clothing industry uses huge amounts of water and energy, and millions of tonnes of clothes end up in landfill every year. Furthermore, as global brands dominate the market, traditional clothing styles and local tailors are disappearing, and an important part of each country's cultural identity is being lost.

      In conclusion, global trends have made clothing more uniform and more disposable, and I believe that this is mainly a negative development.

      Разбор: Первый вопрос («как изменилось?») — описательный, поэтому абзац 2 содержит факты и примеры без оценки. Оценка («positive or negative?») вынесена в абзац 3 и начинается с In my view. Такое чёткое разделение Simon считает самым надёжным способом ответить на двухчастный вопрос.
    5. Cambridge 19. Supermarkets now sell food from all over the world. Positive or negative development?
      Образец (Band 9), 258 слов — план, лексика, разбор
      План: Шаблон Simon «positive or negative» (как его эссе про онлайн-курсы). Вступление: факт + Although…, I believe… positive overall. Абзац 2 — The main drawback of…: выбросы, проблемы местных фермеров, потеря сезонной кухни. Абзац 3 — Despite these negatives…: выбор и здоровье, доход для развивающихся стран, знакомство с культурами. Вывод.

      It is true that supermarkets now offer food from every part of the world, from Spanish oranges to Thai rice. Although this trend has some disadvantages, I believe that it is a positive development overall.

      The main drawback of importing food from distant countries is its impact on the environment. Fruit and vegetables that are flown thousands of kilometres produce far more carbon emissions than food grown locally, and many products need to be refrigerated or packaged in plastic during long journeys. In addition, local farmers may struggle to compete with cheap imports, and some of them may be forced out of business. There is also a risk that people in some countries could lose touch with traditional, seasonal diets and forget how to cook the dishes their grandparents made.

      Despite these negatives, I believe that the global food trade brings greater benefits. Firstly, it gives consumers a much wider choice and allows them to eat fresh fruit and vegetables all year round, which is good for their health. In countries with long winters, it would be difficult to have a balanced diet without imported produce. Secondly, international trade provides vital income for farmers in developing countries, who export products such as coffee, bananas and cocoa. Finally, foreign foods allow people to experience other cultures and to cook dishes from around the world, which can make diets more varied and interesting.

      In conclusion, while I recognise the environmental costs of importing food, I consider the variety and economic benefits it brings to make it a positive development overall.

Аргумент про фермеров в развивающихся странах уравновешивает аргумент про местных фермеров из абзаца 2.
    6. Cambridge 19. Some think competition at work, at school and in daily life is good; others think we should cooperate instead. Discuss both views.
      Образец (Band 9), 263 слов — план, лексика, разбор
      План: Шаблон Simon «discuss both views». Вступление: People have different views about… + своя позиция (сотрудничество ценнее). Абзац 2 — On the one hand…: желание победить мотивирует; конкуренция в бизнесе снижает цены; готовит к взрослой жизни. Абзац 3 — On the other hand, I agree with those who argue…: великие достижения — результат командной работы; вред чрезмерной конкуренции; навыки работы в группе. Вывод.

      People have different views about whether competition or cooperation brings the best results at work, at school and in everyday life. While competition can be motivating, I believe that cooperation is generally more valuable.

      On the one hand, there are several reasons why some people believe that competition is beneficial. The desire to win can motivate people to work harder and achieve more than they would otherwise. For example, a student who wants to come top of the class may study for extra hours, and a salesperson who is competing for a bonus may find new customers. In business, competition between companies leads to better products and lower prices for consumers. Supporters of this view also argue that competition prepares young people for adult life, in which they will have to compete for university places and jobs.

      On the other hand, I agree with those who argue that cooperation leads to better outcomes. Most important achievements in the modern world, from scientific discoveries to the construction of buildings and the development of software, are the result of teamwork rather than individual effort. When people share ideas and skills, they can solve problems that no individual could solve alone. Too much competition, by contrast, can create stress, damage relationships and encourage people to hide information or even cheat. In schools, children who learn to work in groups develop communication and leadership skills that employers value highly.

      In conclusion, competition can sometimes motivate people to perform well, but in my opinion the ability to cooperate is more important for success in education, work and life.

Simon подчёркивает: если вопрос называет несколько областей, ответ должен их затронуть. Своя позиция стоит вторым абзацем и звучит через I agree with those who argue…
    7. Cambridge 19. It is important for everyone, including young people, to save money for the future. Agree / disagree.
      Образец (Band 9), 250 слов — план, лексика, разбор
      План: Шаблон Simon «completely agree». Вступление: перефраз + I completely agree. Абзац 2 — сбережения нужны всем: непредсказуемость жизни, крупные события, пенсии. Абзац 3 — особенно молодым: привычка и самодисциплина, время на рост денег; уступка (молодым тоже надо жить) без смены позиции. Вывод.

      Some people believe that everyone, including young people, should save money for the future. I completely agree with this view.

      In my opinion, saving money is essential because life is unpredictable. People can lose their jobs, become ill or face unexpected expenses, such as car repairs or medical bills. Those who have savings can deal with these situations calmly, whereas those who have nothing may be forced to borrow money at high interest rates and fall into debt. Savings are also necessary for major life events, such as buying a home, starting a business or retiring comfortably. Since state pensions in many countries are becoming less generous, people increasingly need their own savings to support themselves in old age.

      I also believe that young people in particular should develop the habit of saving. Although teenagers and students usually have small incomes, putting aside even a small amount each month teaches them self-discipline and the value of money. Habits formed early in life tend to last, so a young person who learns to save is likely to manage money responsibly as an adult. Furthermore, money saved at a young age has many years to grow through interest or investment. Of course, young people should also enjoy their lives, but this does not mean spending everything they earn on clothes, phones or entertainment.

      In conclusion, saving money protects people from unexpected problems and helps them to achieve their goals, and I believe that this habit should be learned as early as possible.

      Полезная лексика из образца (выделена в тексте)

      Разбор: Вопрос подчёркивает «including young people», и эссе отдаёт молодёжи целый абзац — иначе ответ был бы неполным. Уступка в конце абзаца 3 (Of course… but…) делает позицию разумной, но не меняет её. Язык простой и точный, без редких слов, и это полностью соответствует подходу Simon.
    8. Cambridge 19. The working week should be shorter and people should have a longer weekend. Agree / disagree.
      Образец (Band 9), 250 слов — план, лексика, разбор
      План: Шаблон Simon «agree» с условием. Вступление: перефраз + I agree… as long as… Абзац 2 — польза для людей: отдых, семья, увлечения, здоровье. Абзац 3 — польза для работодателей (эксперименты в Исландии и Великобритании) + уступка: не все профессии, решение — смены. Вывод.

      Some people think that the working week should be reduced so that people have a longer weekend. I agree with this idea, as long as the change is introduced carefully.

      In my opinion, a shorter working week would greatly improve people's quality of life. Many employees work long hours and spend much of the weekend doing household chores, so they have little time left for rest, hobbies or their families. A three-day weekend would allow people to recover from the stress of work, spend more time with their children and elderly relatives, and pursue interests such as sport, learning or volunteering. This would be likely to improve both their physical and mental health, and it may reduce the number of days that people take off sick.

      A four-day week could also benefit employers and the economy. Several trials in countries such as Iceland and the UK have shown that many workers remain just as productive when their hours are reduced, because they are more focused and less tired. Companies that offer shorter weeks may also find it easier to attract and keep staff. However, I accept that this system would not suit every job. Hospitals, schools and public transport need to operate every day, so these services would need to organise shifts rather than simply closing on an extra day. With careful planning, these difficulties could be overcome.

      In conclusion, I believe that a shorter working week and a longer weekend would make people healthier and happier without harming productivity.

Пример с экспериментами в Исландии делает довод конкретным, а уступка (However, I accept that…) с решением показывает, что автор подумал о слабых местах своей позиции.

    Ещё 36 вопросов для тренировки (из сборника Simon)

    Это реальные вопросы Task 2 из сборника «Simon’s Band 9 Essays». Готовых текстов здесь нет: у каждого вопроса — план по шаблону Simon. Сначала напиши эссе сам за 40 минут, потом сверь структуру с планом. Свой вариант можно сравнить с образцами выше на похожие темы.

    1. Families who send their children to private schools should not be required to pay taxes that support the state education system. To what extent do you agree or disagree? (Opinion)
      План по шаблону Simon
      Шаблон «полностью против». Абзац 2: налог — общий вклад в общество, а не плата за услугу (бездетные тоже платят за школы). Абзац 3: если богатые перестанут платить, качество государственных школ упадёт и неравенство вырастет; от хороших школ выигрывают все, включая бизнес богатых.
    2. We cannot help everyone in the world that needs help, so we should only be concerned with our own communities and countries. To what extent do you agree or disagree? (Opinion)
      План по шаблону Simon
      Шаблон «частично» или «против». Абзац 2 (I accept that…): местные проблемы видны, помогать проще, результат можно проверить. Абзац 3 (At the same time, I believe…): там, где бедность острее, небольшие деньги спасают жизни (вакцины, чистая вода); эпидемии и климат — общие проблемы.
    3. There are many different types of music in the world today. Why do we need music? Is the traditional music of a country more important than the international music that is heard everywhere nowadays? (Two-part)
      План по шаблону Simon
      Абзац 2 — зачем музыка: эмоции, общение, память, праздники, обучение детей. Абзац 3 — мнение (например, традиционная важнее): часть идентичности, связь поколений, а международный поп — в основном коммерческий продукт.
    4. Some people think that all teenagers should be required to do unpaid work in their free time to help the local community. Do you agree or disagree? (Opinion)
      План по шаблону Simon
      Шаблон «против обязательности». Абзац 2: подростки и так загружены учёбой, им нужен отдых и спорт. Абзац 3: принуждение противоречит смыслу волонтёрства и вызовет недовольство; лучше поощрять (сертификаты, баллы для поступления).
    5. Some people believe that hobbies need to be difficult to be enjoyable. To what extent do you agree or disagree? (Opinion)
      План по шаблону Simon
      Шаблон «против», основа — примеры. Абзац 2 (On the one hand): простые хобби (плавание, прогулки, фото) приносят радость и снимают стресс. Абзац 3 (On the other hand): сложные хобби дают удовольствие от достижения, но это лишь один вид удовольствия. Личные примеры здесь особенно уместны.
    6. In the developed world, average life expectancy is increasing. What problems will this cause for individuals and society? Suggest some measures that could be taken to reduce the impact of ageing populations. (Problem / solution)
      План по шаблону Simon
      Абзац 2 — проблемы: больше пенсионеров на одного работающего, налоговая нагрузка, расходы на медицину, уход за пожилыми родственниками. Абзац 3 — меры: поднять пенсионный возраст, привлекать трудовых мигрантов, личные пенсионные накопления, профилактика здоровья.
    7. Some people regard video games as harmless fun, or even as a useful educational tool. Others believe that video games are having an adverse effect on the people who play them. In your opinion, do the drawbacks of video games outweigh the benefits? (Advantages / disadvantages)
      План по шаблону Simon
      Шаблон «outweigh». Абзац 2: плюсы — логика, реакция, обучающие и симуляционные игры. Абзац 3 (However, I would argue that these benefits are outweighed by the drawbacks): зависимость, недосып, малоподвижность, вытеснение живого общения.
    8. Foreign visitors should pay more than local visitors for cultural and historical attractions. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this opinion? (Opinion)
      План по шаблону Simon
      Шаблон «против» с опровержением. Абзац 2: The argument in favour… would be that местные платят налоги; However, туристы тратят деньги в стране (отели, еда, транспорт). Абзац 3: высокие цены отпугнут туристов, и денег на сохранение памятников станет меньше.
    9. Nowadays animal experiments are widely used to develop new medicines and to test the safety of other products. Some people argue that these experiments should be banned because it is morally wrong to cause animals to suffer, while others are in favour of them because of their benefits to humanity. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. (Discussion)
      План по шаблону Simon
      Позиция-компромисс: запретить для косметики, допускать для жизненно важных лекарств, пока нет альтернатив. Абзац 2 — этические доводы против. Абзац 3 — медицинская польза + призыв развивать альтернативы (клеточные модели, компьютерные симуляции).
    10. Some people believe that individuals can achieve more in egalitarian societies. Others believe that high levels of personal achievement are possible only if individuals are free to succeed or fail according to their individual merits. What is your view? (Opinion)
      План по шаблону Simon
      Сначала определи egalitarian (равные права и возможности). Абзац 2: бесплатное образование и медицина позволяют раскрыться талантам из любых семей. Абзац 3: равенство возможностей не отменяет свободы добиться успеха или потерпеть неудачу; справедливость мотивирует сильнее.
    11. Explain some of the ways in which humans are damaging the environment. What can governments do to address these problems? What can individual people do? (Three-part)
      План по шаблону Simon
      Три вопроса — пять абзацев (так делает Simon). Абзац 2 — проблемы: выбросы, отходы, вырубка лесов. Абзац 3 — государство: законы об ограничении выбросов, «зелёные» налоги, возобновляемая энергия. Абзац 4 — люди: общественный транспорт, переработка, меньше упаковки.
    12. Universities should accept equal numbers of male and female students in every subject. To what extent do you agree or disagree? (Opinion)
      План по шаблону Simon
      Шаблон «против». Абзац 2: непрактично — интерес к специальностям разный, некоторые курсы не удастся заполнить. Абзац 3: несправедливо — отбор должен идти по способностям. Можно предложить альтернативу: программы, которые поощряют девушек идти в инженерию, а юношей — в педагогику.
    13. Some people think that museums should be enjoyable places to entertain people, while others believe that the purpose of museums is to educate. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. (Discussion)
      План по шаблону Simon
      Позиция: хороший музей совмещает оба. Абзац 2: развлечение привлекает посетителей (интерактив, игры, зрелищные экспозиции). Абзац 3: цель — научить чему-то новому (гиды, аудиогиды, пояснения). Вывод: интересно + полезно одновременно.
    14. Several languages are in danger of extinction because they are spoken by very small numbers of people. Some people say that governments should spend public money on saving these languages, while others believe that would be a waste of money. Discuss both these views and give your opinion. (Discussion)
      План по шаблону Simon
      Абзац 2 — доводы «пустая трата»: дорогие программы ради малого числа носителей; один общий язык экономит деньги. Абзац 3 — мнение «сохранять»: язык связан с культурой, историей и обычаями; потеря языка = потеря разнообразия.
    15. Nowadays the way many people interact with each other has changed because of technology. In what ways has technology affected the types of relationships that people make? Has this been a positive or negative development? (Two-part)
      План по шаблону Simon
      Абзац 2 — как изменилось: деловые связи через границы, учёба онлайн с преподавателем в другой стране, дружба через соцсети. Абзац 3 — оценка: On the one hand — сотрудничество стало проще; On the other hand — виртуальная дружба может заменять живую.
    16. Nowadays celebrities are more famous for their glamour and wealth than for their achievements, and this sets a bad example to young people. To what extent do you agree or disagree? (Opinion)
      План по шаблону Simon
      Шаблон «частично». Абзац 2 (On the one hand): звёзды реалити-шоу продвигают внешность и деньги вместо труда. Абзац 3 (On the other hand): спортсмены, музыканты, актёры, добившиеся всего трудом, — хороший пример для детей.
    17. When choosing a job, the salary is the most important consideration. To what extent do you agree or disagree? (Opinion)
      План по шаблону Simon
      Шаблон «против» с уступкой. Абзац 2 (I agree that…): деньги нужны для жилья, еды, семьи. Абзац 3 (Nevertheless, I believe…): атмосфера и коллеги, профессиональный рост и удовлетворённость, желание приносить пользу так же важны.
    18. Some people think that in the modern world we are more dependent on each other, while others think that people have become more independent. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. (Discussion)
      План по шаблону Simon
      Абзац 2 — «зависимы»: дорогое жильё и помощь родителей, бабушки и няни для детей работающих пар. Абзац 3 — мнение «независимы»: маленькие семьи, учёба и работа далеко от дома, технологии позволяют работать откуда угодно.
    19. Wild animals have no place in the 21st century, so protecting them is a waste of resources. To what extent do you agree or disagree? (Opinion)
      План по шаблону Simon
      Шаблон «полностью против», два тезиса вопроса — два абзаца. Абзац 2: у людей нет права решать, каким видам жить. Абзац 3: защита природы — не трата ресурсов: экосистемы дают кислород, опыление, стабильный климат.
    20. Happiness is considered very important in life. Why is it difficult to define? What factors are important in achieving happiness? (Two-part)
      План по шаблону Simon
      Абзац 2 — почему трудно определить: субъективное чувство, у каждого свои источники радости. Абзац 3 — условия: безопасность и базовые потребности, здоровье, близкие люди, свобода, смысл.
    21. The older generations tend to have very traditional ideas about how people should live, think and behave. However, some people believe that these ideas are not helpful in preparing younger generations for modern life. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this view? (Opinion)
      План по шаблону Simon
      Шаблон «частично». Абзац 2: часть идей устарела (работа на всю жизнь, традиционные роли мужчин и женщин). Абзац 3: другие ценности по-прежнему полезны (трудолюбие, вежливость, уважение, чувство общности).
    22. Many people prefer to watch foreign films rather than locally produced films. Why could this be? Should governments give more financial support to local film industries? (Two-part)
      План по шаблону Simon
      Абзац 2 — причины: огромные бюджеты, спецэффекты, звёзды и реклама крупных студий. Абзац 3 — мнение «поддерживать»: шанс для местных талантов, рабочие места, доходы, туризм (фильмы рекламируют страну).
    23. Some people think that strict punishments for driving offences are the key to reducing traffic accidents. Others, however, believe that other measures would be more effective in improving road safety. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion. (Discussion)
      План по шаблону Simon
      Позиция: сочетание мер. Абзац 2: наказания сдерживают (штрафы, лишение прав). Абзац 3: обучение водителей, безопасный дизайн дорог (лежачие полицейские, камеры), хороший общественный транспорт.
    24. These days more fathers stay at home and take care of their children while mothers go out to work. What could be the reasons for this? Do you think it is a positive or a negative development? (Two-part)
      План по шаблону Simon
      Абзац 2 — причины: равенство прав, женщины получают образование и делают карьеру, иногда зарабатывают больше, мужчинам стало социально приемлемо сидеть с детьми. Абзац 3 — оценка «позитивно»: семьи сами решают по своим обстоятельствам.
    25. More and more people are migrating to cities in search of a better life, but city life can be extremely difficult. Explain some of the difficulties of living in a city. How can governments make urban life better for everyone? (Problem / solution)
      План по шаблону Simon
      Абзац 2 — трудности: стоимость жизни и жилья, пробки и загрязнение, преступность, переполненный транспорт. Абзац 3 — меры: доступное жильё, чистый общественный транспорт и плата за въезд, развитие малых городов и регионов.
    26. In some countries, many more people are choosing to live alone nowadays than in the past. Do you think this is a positive or negative development? (Positive / negative)
      План по шаблону Simon
      Можно дать сбалансированный ответ, но сформулировать его ясно во вступлении. Абзац 2 — плюсы: самостоятельность, бытовые навыки, спрос на жильё полезен строительству. Абзац 3 — минусы: одиночество, все счета на одном человеке, рост цен на жильё.
    27. Some people think that all university students should study whatever they like. Others believe that they should only be allowed to study subjects that will be useful in the future, such as those related to science and technology. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion. (Discussion)
      План по шаблону Simon
      Абзац 2 — доводы за «полезные» предметы: рабочие места, зарплаты, нехватка специалистов, рост экономики. Абзац 3 — мнение «свобода выбора»: увлечённые студенты учатся лучше, никто не знает, какие знания понадобятся в будущем.
    28. Some people who have been in prison become good citizens later, and it is often argued that these are the best people to talk to teenagers about the dangers of committing a crime. To what extent do you agree or disagree? (Opinion)
      План по шаблону Simon
      Шаблон «полностью за». Абзац 2: подростки охотнее слушают тех, кто говорит из опыта; живые истории производят сильное впечатление. Абзац 3: альтернативы слабее — полиция и учителя воспринимаются как «власть», фильмы не дают задать вопросы.
    29. In many countries, a small number of people earn extremely high salaries. Some people believe that this is good for the country, but others think that governments should not allow salaries above a certain level. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion. (Discussion)
      План по шаблону Simon
      Абзац 2 — доводы «за» высокие зарплаты: привлекают таланты, мотивируют, приносят налоги. Абзац 3 — свою позицию (любую) объясни: например, «максимальная зарплата» сокращает разрыв, позволяет поднять минимальную оплату, снижает недовольство.
    30. Some people think that instead of preventing climate change, we need to find a way to live with it. To what extent do you agree or disagree? (Opinion)
      План по шаблону Simon
      Шаблон «полностью против». Абзац 2 — что можно сделать: законы о выбросах, «зелёные» налоги, возобновляемая энергия, личные действия, голосование. Абзац 3 — чем опасно «жить с этим»: наводнения, переселение миллионов, болезни и голод.
    31. Many governments think that economic progress is their most important goal. Some people, however, think that other types of progress are equally important for a country. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion. (Discussion)
      План по шаблону Simon
      Абзац 2 — почему экономика важна: рабочие места, деньги на инфраструктуру и услуги, влияние в мире. Абзац 3 — мнение: социальная справедливость, экология, здоровье и счастье граждан не менее важны.
    32. As well as making money, businesses also have social responsibilities. To what extent do you agree or disagree? (Opinion)
      План по шаблону Simon
      Шаблон «за» с уступкой. Абзац 2 (On the one hand, I accept…): без прибыли компания не выживет. Абзац 3 (On the other hand…): справедливая зарплата, забота об экологии, честная уплата налогов, поддержка местных проектов.
    33. Some universities now offer their courses on the Internet so that people can study online. Is this a positive or negative development? (Positive / negative)
      План по шаблону Simon
      Шаблон Simon «positive». Абзац 2 (The main drawback…): меньше живого общения с преподавателями и однокурсниками, трудно держать мотивацию. Абзац 3 (Despite the negatives…): гибкий график, ниже стоимость, доступ для людей любого возраста и из любого места.
    34. It is inevitable that traditional cultures will be lost as technology develops. Technology and traditional cultures are incompatible. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this view? (Opinion)
      План по шаблону Simon
      Шаблон «частично» (I partly agree…). Абзац 2: в индустриальных странах технологии разрушили деревенские общины и традиции. Абзац 3: в других местах традиции живут, а технологии даже помогают (мобильная связь фермерам, запись языков и музыки).
    35. Most people have forgotten the meaning behind traditional or religious festivals; during festival periods, people nowadays only want to enjoy themselves. To what extent do you agree or disagree? (Opinion)
      План по шаблону Simon
      Шаблон «частично». Абзац 2: да, на первом месте подарки, покупки, отдых и праздничная еда. Абзац 3: но смысл праздников передаётся в школах и семьях, и люди его знают.
    36. Extreme sports such as sky diving and skiing are very dangerous and should be banned. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this view? (Opinion)
      План по шаблону Simon
      Шаблон «полностью против». Абзац 2: риск можно контролировать — обучение, правила, инструкторы, снаряжение. Абзац 3: люди вправе сами выбирать досуг, а запрет невозможно обеспечить (горы, океан далеко от полиции).

    Speaking

    Содержание

    Темы актуального сезона: сентябрь–декабрь 2026. Списки составлены по сообщениям кандидатов (официально IELTS вопросы не публикует), поэтому на экзамене формулировка может немного отличаться. Карточки с пометкой NEW появились в этом сезоне.

    Формат (11–14 минут)

    ЧастьВремяЧто происходитКак отвечать
