      They tend to become more realistic. At twenty people dream of changing the world. Later, many focus on family, health and stability. That isn't giving up. It's a change of priorities.

    49. Describe an interesting video that you watched on the internet.
    You should say:
    • what the video was about
    • where you found it
    • why you watched it
    • and explain why you found it interesting
    Part 3:
    • Why are short videos so popular?
    • Can people learn real skills from online videos?
    • Should children's screen time be limited?
    Образец ответа (Band 8), разбор и ответы Part 3

    I'd like to talk about a video I watched a couple of months ago about how a pencil is made. It sounds dull, I know. I found it by accident. I'd been watching something about study techniques, and it appeared in the list of suggestions. I clicked on it out of curiosity, expecting to watch a minute, and ended up watching all twenty. The video followed the whole process, from cutting the cedar wood into thin sheets to mixing graphite with clay, baking the leads, gluing them between two pieces of wood and finally painting and sharpening. What made it so interesting was the realisation that an object I've used thousands of times, and which costs almost nothing, is the result of dozens of precise steps and materials from several continents. The filming was beautiful too, with close-ups and no commentary, just the sound of the machines, which was strangely calming. It changed the way I look at ordinary things. For days afterwards I kept wondering how other everyday objects, like zips or matches, are made. I even recommended it to my friends, who thought I'd gone mad until they watched it.

    Лексика: by accident — случайно; out of curiosity — из любопытства; end up watching — в итоге посмотреть; close-up — крупный план; commentary — закадровый текст
    Разбор: Past Perfect Continuous (I'd been watching), from… to…, эмфаза What made it so interesting was…, keep + -ing. Самоирония (It sounds dull, I know) звучит естественно.
    Part 3 — образцы ответов
    1. Why are short videos so popular?

      Because they fit into any spare moment and demand almost no concentration. The apps also learn what each person likes and serve up more of it, which makes them very hard to stop watching.

    2. Can people learn real skills from online videos?

      Yes, definitely. I've learned to cook several dishes and fix a bicycle tyre that way. Seeing something done is often clearer than reading instructions. But for complex skills you still need practice and feedback from a person.

    3. Should children's screen time be limited?

      For young children, I think so. Too much screen time takes away from sleep, play and conversation. But the limit should come with alternatives. It's no use taking the tablet away if there's nothing else to do.

    50. Describe some local news that people in your town or city were very interested in.
    You should say:
    • what the news was
    • how you heard about it
    • who was involved
    • and explain why people were interested
    Part 3:
    • Do people care more about local or international news?
    • Can we trust news on social media?
    • Will newspapers disappear?
    Образец ответа (Band 8), разбор и ответы Part 3

    I'd like to talk about a piece of local news from about a year ago that everyone in my city was discussing: the opening of a new metro line. I first heard about it from my father, who had read it on a news channel on his phone, and within an hour it was all over social media. The line connects the southern suburbs, where a huge number of people live, with the city centre. Until then, residents of those districts had relied on overcrowded buses, and the journey could take over an hour. The people involved were, of course, the city authorities and the construction company, but the real stars were the first passengers. The news showed crowds queuing to ride on the opening day, including elderly people who simply wanted to see the new stations. People were interested for obvious reasons. It affected the daily lives of hundreds of thousands. There was also a lot of debate. Some complained that it had opened two years late and cost more than promised. Personally, I was delighted, because one of the new stations is ten minutes from my grandmother's home.

    Лексика: be all over social media — разойтись по соцсетям; suburbs — окраины, пригороды; rely on — зависеть от; queue — стоять в очереди; delighted — в восторге
    Разбор: Past Perfect (had read, had relied, had opened), косвенная речь (Some complained that…), пассив не перегружает. Личная причина в конце делает ответ живым.
    Part 3 — образцы ответов
    1. Do people care more about local or international news?

      It depends on what's happening. Local news affects daily life directly, such as roads, prices and schools, so people follow it closely. But when there's a major international event, everyone's attention shifts.

    2. Can we trust news on social media?

      Not without checking. Anyone can post anything, and false stories often spread faster than true ones because they're more shocking. I usually look for the same story from an established source before I believe it.

    3. Will newspapers disappear?

      The printed versions may well disappear, or become a luxury. But the organisations behind them will survive online, because people will always need professional journalists to check facts and investigate.

    Live Speaking

    Экзамен по Speaking с виртуальным экзаменатором Emma. Она говорит голосом, ты отвечаешь в микрофон, а сайт сам понимает, когда ты закончил, и задаёт следующий вопрос. Порядок как на настоящем IELTS: знакомство, Part 1, карточка Part 2 с минутой на подготовку, Part 3.

    Что тренируем

    Как это работает и как получить максимум
    • Наушники. Лучше надеть их, чтобы микрофон не слышал голос экзаменатора.
    • Браузер. Распознавание речи работает в Chrome и Edge (на компьютере и Android) и в Safari на iPhone. В других браузерах тест идёт без расшифровки, но запись голоса сохраняется.
    • Конец ответа. Когда ты замолчал на 2–3 секунды (в Part 2 — дольше), экзаменатор продолжает. Можно нажать «Я закончил ответ».
    • Живой диалог: экзаменатор реагирует на ответы («Great answer! Let's move on…») и задаёт уточняющие вопросы по тому, что ты сказал: на «да» — один вопрос, на «нет» — другой. На слишком короткий ответ попросит рассказать подробнее.
    • Строгий режим — как настоящий IELTS: экзаменатор не комментирует ответы и только иногда спрашивает «Why?».
    • После теста будет запись всего экзамена, расшифровка, темп речи, слова-паразиты и короткие ответы, а также ссылки на образцы ответов на эти же вопросы.
    E

    Introduction

    Part 2 · карточка

    You should say:

      Слушай вопрос

      Тренажёр слов

      Карточки из новых слов всех текстов Reading и полезных выражений из образцов Writing. Каждое слово показано в предложении из текста. Слова, которые ты не вспомнил, возвращаются чаще, а выученные — всё реже: через 1, 3, 7, 14, 30 и 60 дней.

      Колода

      Совет: 20 слов в день, то есть 10–15 минут. Произноси каждое слово вслух и придумай с ним своё предложение.

      Grammar

      27 тем в 4 этапах: план урока, теория с типичными ошибками, практика с автопроверкой и пояснениями, тест по каждой теме и итоговый тест на 100 вопросов после каждого этапа. Тема считается освоенной, когда тест сдан на 85% и выше.

      ← Все темы

      Этап 1 — база · тема 1

      1. Sentence Structure

      Порядок слов, подлежащее it/there, простые, сложносочинённые и сложноподчинённые предложения

      План урока

      Цель: Строить грамматически полные английские предложения с правильным порядком слов и соединять их без ошибок пунктуации, которые на IELTS снижают оценку за Grammatical Range and Accuracy.

      1. Базовый порядок слов: подлежащее → сказуемое → дополнение (SVO).
      2. Подлежащее обязательно: «пустые» it и there.
      3. Где стоят наречия частоты, места и времени.
      4. Три типа предложений: simple, compound, complex.
      5. Ошибки границ предложения: fragment, run-on, comma splice.
      6. Практика 1–4 и тест по теме.

      Практика: 36 заданий в 4 блоках · тест: 15 вопросов

      Теория

      1. Порядок слов SVO

      В русском порядок слов свободный («Книгу купил брат» = «Брат купил книгу»). В английском смысл держится на порядке: подлежащее (S) → сказуемое (V) → дополнение (O) → обстоятельства (место, время).

      SVOМестоВремя
      My brotherboughta new laptopin Londonlast week.
      The governmenthas introduceda new law—this year.

      The number of tourists rose sharply in 2020. (не Sharply rose the number…)

      2. Подлежащее есть всегда: it и there

      В русском можно сказать «Холодно», «Важно учиться», «В городе много парков». В английском без подлежащего нельзя: ставим формальное it или there.

      • It — погода, время, расстояние, оценка: It is cold. It is 5 km to the station. It is important to sleep well.
      • There is / there are — «есть, имеется, находится»: There are many parks in the city. There was a sharp rise in prices.

      ✗ Is important to protect the environment. ✓ It is important to protect the environment.

      ✗ In my city have many problems. ✓ There are many problems in my city.

      ✗ It has many parks in my city. ✓ There are many parks in my city.

      3. Место наречий

      • Наречия частоты (always, usually, often, never) — перед смысловым глаголом, но после be: She often works late. She is often late.
      • Место → время в конце предложения: I met him at the station yesterday.
      • Наречие не ставится между глаголом и дополнением.

      ✗ I like very much football. ✓ I like football very much.

      ✗ He speaks very well English. ✓ He speaks English very well.

      4. Три типа предложений

      ТипКак устроеноПример
      Simpleодно подлежащее + одно сказуемоеPrices rose.
      Compoundдва простых + and, but, or, so, yet (с запятой перед союзом)Prices rose, but sales remained stable.
      Complexглавное + придаточное с because, although, when, if, while, which, who, thatAlthough prices rose, sales remained stable.

      Если придаточное стоит первым, после него ставится запятая: When the factory closed, many people lost their jobs. Если вторым — запятая обычно не нужна: Many people lost their jobs when the factory closed.

      5. Ошибки границ предложения

      • Fragment — кусок без главного предложения: ✗ Because it is cheap. — это не предложение.
      • Comma splice — два предложения через запятую: ✗ Prices rose, people bought less.
      • Run-on — два предложения вообще без знака.

      Исправить можно точкой, союзом, точкой с запятой или придаточным.

      ✗ Many people moved to cities, they wanted better jobs. ✓ Many people moved to cities because they wanted better jobs.

      ✗ Because public transport is cheap. ✓ Many people use public transport because it is cheap.

      IELTS экзаменатор оценивает range (разнообразие) и accuracy (точность). Для Band 7 нужно «a variety of complex structures» и частые безошибочные предложения. Смешивай простые, сложносочинённые и сложноподчинённые предложения, но не ценой ошибок: comma splice — одна из самых частых ошибок, которая не даёт подняться выше 6.0.

      Практика 1. Порядок слов

      Выбери правильный вариант.

      1 Choose the correct sentence.
      • A Sharply rose the price of oil.
      • B The price of oil rose sharply.
      • C The price sharply of oil rose.
       ✔ B The price of oil rose sharply.
      2 Choose the correct sentence.
      • A I like very much reading.
      • B I very much like reading books.
      • C I like reading very much.
       ✔ C I like reading very much. — Наречие не ставится между глаголом и дополнением.
      3 Choose the correct sentence.
      • A She is always on time.
      • B She always is on time.
      • C Always she is on time.
       ✔ A She is always on time. — С глаголом be наречие частоты стоит после него.
      4 Choose the correct sentence.
      • A They play often tennis.
      • B They often play tennis.
      • C They play tennis often always.
       ✔ B They often play tennis.
      5 Choose the correct sentence.
      • A I met yesterday my friend at the cinema.
      • B I met my friend yesterday at the cinema.
      • C I met my friend at the cinema yesterday.
       ✔ C I met my friend at the cinema yesterday. — Сначала место, потом время.
      6 Choose the correct sentence.
      • A He speaks English fluently.
      • B He speaks fluently English.
      • C Fluently he English speaks.
       ✔ A He speaks English fluently.
      7 Choose the correct sentence.
      • A Last year visited the museum two million people.
      • B Two million people visited the museum last year.
      • C Two million people last year the museum visited.
       ✔ B Two million people visited the museum last year.
      8 Choose the correct sentence.
      • A We have never been to Japan.
      • B We never have been to Japan.
      • C We have been never to Japan.
       ✔ A We have never been to Japan. — Наречие частоты — между вспомогательным и смысловым глаголом.
      9 Choose the correct sentence.
      • A The government should strictly control advertising.
      • B The government should control strictly advertising.
      • C Strictly the government should control advertising.
       ✔ A The government should strictly control advertising.
      10 Choose the correct sentence.
      • A I get up usually at seven.
      • B I usually get up at seven.
      • C I get usually up at seven.
       ✔ B I usually get up at seven. — Наречие частоты стоит перед смысловым глаголом.

      Практика 2. It или there?

      Впиши правильную форму или слово. Подсказка — в скобках.

      1 is important to get enough sleep. ✔ It
      2 are three main reasons for this problem. ✔ There
      3 was a sharp fall in sales in 2010. ✔ There
      4 takes about two hours to get to the airport. ✔ It
      5 is no doubt that technology has changed our lives. ✔ There
      6 is often said that money cannot buy happiness. ✔ It
      7 were fewer tourists in 2020 than in 2019. ✔ There
      8 is difficult to find a cheap flat in London. ✔ It
      9 has been a significant increase in online shopping. ✔ There
      10 is a pity that the museum is closed. ✔ It

      Практика 3. Найди ошибку

      Найди ошибку: выбери букву части, в которой она есть.

      1 A Is very important B for children C to read D every day. ✔ A — Нет подлежащего: It is very important…
      2 A In my country B have C many beautiful D old towns. ✔ B — There are many beautiful old towns in my country.
      3 A Prices increased B dramatically, C people D bought less food. ✔ B — Comma splice: нужна точка или so/and: …dramatically, so people bought less food.
      4 A Many students B work part-time. C Because D university is expensive. ✔ C — Fragment: …part-time because university is expensive.
      5 A My father B speaks C very well D French. ✔ C — …speaks French very well.
      6 A Although B the city is crowded, C but D it is exciting. ✔ C — Although и but вместе не используются.
      7 A It B has C a lot of parks D in our city. ✔ B — There are a lot of parks in our city.
      8 A When I arrived, B the meeting C had already D start. ✔ D — После had нужна третья форма: had already started.

      Практика 4. Соедини предложения

      Выбери правильный вариант.

      1 People live longer. Health care has improved. → Best combination:
      • A People live longer, health care has improved.
      • B People live longer because health care has improved.
      • C Because health care has improved. People live longer.
       ✔ B People live longer because health care has improved.
      2 The flat is small. It is very comfortable. →
      • A The flat is small, it is very comfortable.
      • B Although the flat is small, but it is comfortable.
      • C The flat is small, but it is very comfortable.
       ✔ C The flat is small, but it is very comfortable.
      3 It was raining. We stayed at home. →
      • A It was raining, so we stayed at home.
      • B It was raining, we stayed at home.
      • C It was raining so, we stayed at home.
       ✔ A It was raining, so we stayed at home.
      4 The museum opened in 1990. It attracts many visitors. →
      • A The museum, which opened in 1990, attracts many visitors.
      • B The museum which opened in 1990, attracts many visitors.
      • C The museum, it opened in 1990, attracts many visitors.
       ✔ A The museum, which opened in 1990, attracts many visitors.
      5 Sales fell. Profits rose. →
      • A Sales fell, profits rose.
      • B While sales fell, profits rose.
      • C While sales fell profits, rose.
       ✔ B While sales fell, profits rose.
      6 You can take the bus. You can walk. →
      • A You can take the bus, or you can walk.
      • B You can take the bus, you can walk.
      • C You can take the bus or, you can walk.
       ✔ A You can take the bus, or you can walk.
      7 He studied hard. He failed the exam. →
      • A He studied hard, he failed the exam.
      • B He studied hard, yet he failed the exam.
      • C Despite he studied hard, he failed the exam.
       ✔ B He studied hard, yet he failed the exam. — Despite + существительное/-ing, а не + предложение.
      8 Children watch too much TV. They do not exercise enough. →
      • A Children watch too much TV, and they do not exercise enough.
      • B Children watch too much TV and, they do not exercise enough.
      • C Children watch too much TV, they do not exercise enough.
       ✔ A Children watch too much TV, and they do not exercise enough.

      Этап 1 — база · тема 2

      2. Parts of Speech

      Части речи и словообразование: как из economy получить economic, economical и economically

      План урока

      Цель: Узнавать части речи в предложении и уверенно выбирать нужную форму слова (word form). Ошибки в форме слова — одни из самых частых в Writing и в заданиях на заполнение пропусков в Reading и Listening.

      1. Восемь частей речи и их роль в предложении.
      2. Как по месту в предложении понять, какая часть речи нужна.
      3. Суффиксы существительных, прилагательных, глаголов и наречий.
      4. Слова-«ловушки»: economic / economical, sensible / sensitive и т.д.
      5. Практика 1–4 и тест по теме.

      Практика: 38 заданий в 4 блоках · тест: 15 вопросов

      Теория

      1. Восемь частей речи

      Часть речиЧто делаетПример
      Noun (существительное)предмет, человек, понятиеpollution, government, growth
      Verb (глагол)действие или состояниеincrease, depend, seem
      Adjective (прилагательное)описывает существительноеrapid growth, a serious problem
      Adverb (наречие)описывает глагол, прилагательное, всё предложениеgrew rapidly, extremely serious
      Pronoun (местоимение)заменяет существительноеit, they, which
      Preposition (предлог)связывает словаin, on, by, of
      Conjunction (союз)связывает части предложенияand, but, because, although
      Determiner (определитель)стоит перед существительнымa, the, this, some, many

      2. Место подскажет часть речи

      • После артикля / определителя / прилагательного — существительное: the ___ of the city → the development.
      • Перед существительным — прилагательное: a ___ change → a significant change.
      • После be, seem, become, look — прилагательное: It seems important.
      • Рядом с глаголом, описывая как — наречие: rose significantly.
      • Перед прилагательным — наречие: extremely expensive.
      • После подлежащего (и модального глагола) — глагол: We must reduce costs.

      3. Суффиксы

      СуществительноеПрилагательноеГлаголНаречие
      -tion, -ment, -ness, -ity, -ance/-ence, -er/-or, -ism-al, -ful, -less, -ous, -ive, -able/-ible, -ic-ise/-ize, -en, -ify, -ate-ly
      pollution, development, happiness, reality, importanceenvironmental, harmful, useless, dangerous, effective, reliable, economicmodernise, widen, simplify, motivaterapidly, effectively

      4. Пары-ловушки

      • economic (экономический: economic growth) — economical (экономный: an economical car).
      • historic (исторически важный: a historic moment) — historical (относящийся к истории: historical documents).
      • sensible (разумный) — sensitive (чувствительный).
      • effective (эффективный, даёт результат) — efficient (экономит время и ресурсы).
      • childish (ребяческий, негатив) — childlike (детский, непосредственный, позитив).

      ✗ The economical situation is getting worse. ✓ The economic situation is getting worse.

      ✗ There was a significant rise of the population growing. ✓ There was a significant rise in population growth.

      ✗ This is a very danger situation. ✓ This is a very dangerous situation.

      ✗ The number of tourists increased dramatical. ✓ The number of tourists increased dramatically.

      IELTS в Task 1 удобно чередовать глагол + наречие и прилагательное + существительное: Sales rose sharply = There was a sharp rise in sales. Это и есть «range» без сложной грамматики. В Listening и Reading форма слова в пропуске должна грамматически подходить к предложению: если перед пропуском стоит a, ответ — существительное в единственном числе.

      Практика 1. Какая часть речи нужна?

      Этап 1 — база · тема 3

      3. Pronouns

      Личные, притяжательные, возвратные и неопределённые местоимения; it, they, one, each other

      План урока

      Цель: Без ошибок выбирать форму местоимения и следить, чтобы каждое местоимение ясно указывало, к чему относится. Неясные it/they/this снижают оценку за Coherence and Cohesion.

      1. Субъектные и объектные формы: I / me, they / them.
      2. Притяжательные: my / mine, their / theirs.
      3. Возвратные: myself, themselves — и когда они НЕ нужны.
      4. Неопределённые: some-, any-, no-, every- + body/thing/where.
      5. One / ones, each other, it vs this, «общие» you / they.
      6. Практика 1–4 и тест по теме.

      Практика: 35 заданий в 4 блоках · тест: 15 вопросов

      Теория

      1. Основная таблица

      ПодлежащееДополнениеПритяж. + сущ.Притяж. без сущ.Возвратное
      Imemy bookminemyself
      youyouyouryoursyourself / yourselves
      hehimhishishimself
      sheherherhersherself
      ititits—itself
      weusouroursourselves
      theythemtheirtheirsthemselves
      • После предлога — объектная форма: between you and me, for them.
      • its (его/её — о предмете) без апострофа; it's = it is / it has.
      • В английском нет слова «свой»: выбирай по лицу. They love their children. She sold her car.

      ✗ My friend and me went to the cinema. ✓ My friend and I went to the cinema.

      ✗ The company changed it's logo. ✓ The company changed its logo.

      ✗ Every student must bring his own book. (если пол неизвестен) ✓ Every student must bring their own book.

      2. Возвратные местоимения

      Нужны, когда подлежащее и дополнение — одно лицо: She hurt herself. Enjoy yourselves! Также для усиления: The president himself opened the bridge. By myself = один, без помощи.

      С глаголами feel, relax, concentrate, meet, wash, dress, shave возвратное обычно не нужно (в отличие от русского «-ся»).

      ✗ I feel myself tired. ✓ I feel tired.

      ✗ We met ourselves at the station. ✓ We met at the station.

      ✗ They help themselves each other. ✓ They help each other.

      3. Неопределённые местоимения

      some-any-no-every-
      -body / -onesomebodyanybodynobodyeverybody
      -thingsomethinganythingnothingeverything
      -wheresomewhereanywherenowhereeverywhere
      • some- — утверждения и предложения/просьбы: Would you like something to drink?
      • any- — вопросы и отрицания; в утверждении = «любой»: You can call me any time.
      • no- — уже содержит отрицание: ✗ I don't know nobody → ✓ I don't know anybody / ✓ I know nobody.
      • Глагол после everybody, nobody, everything — в единственном числе: Everybody knows this.

      4. One / ones, each other, it / this

      • one / ones заменяют исчисляемое существительное: I don't like the red shirt; I prefer the blue one.
      • each other / one another — «друг друга»: They love each other.
      • it указывает на конкретный предмет; this — на целую мысль из предыдущего предложения: Prices rose sharply. This led to protests.
      • Обобщённое «люди»: people, you (разговорное), we (мы, общество), one (очень формально). В эссе лучше people или we.
      IELTS в Writing каждое it / they / this должно однозначно указывать назад. Если в предыдущем предложении два существительных, лучше повтори одно из них или используй this + существительное: This trend…, This problem…, These changes… — это прямой путь к высокой оценке за Cohesion.

      • A me
      • B I
      • C myself
       ✔ B I

      • A I

      Тест по теме: Pronouns

      • B them
      • C ones
       ✔ B them
      6 Did you go ____ interesting on holiday?
      • A somewhere
      • B anywhere
      • C nowhere

      • A Everyone
      • B Anyone
      • C Each other
       ✔ A Everyone
      8 Unemployment rose to 12%. ____ was the highest level for 20 years.

      Этап 1 — база · тема 4

      4. Articles

      a / an / the / без артикля: правила, исключения и типичные «артиклевые» места в IELTS

      План урока

      Цель: Ставить артикли автоматически в типичных ситуациях: первое и повторное упоминание, обобщения, уникальные предметы, названия, устойчивые выражения и язык графиков Task 1.

      1. Зачем артикль: «какой-то» (a/an) или «тот самый» (the).
      2. A или an — по звуку, а не по букве.
      3. The: известное, единственное, превосходная степень, «the … of».
      4. Нулевой артикль: обобщения во множественном числе и с неисчисляемыми.
      5. Названия: страны, реки, горы, организации.
      6. Устойчивые выражения: go to school, in hospital, by car.
      7. Практика 1–4 и тест по теме.

      Практика: 42 заданий в 4 блоках · тест: 15 вопросов

      Теория

      1. Главная логика

      • a / an — один из многих, «какой-то», впервые: I saw a film last night.
      • the — конкретный, понятно какой: The film was about climate change.
      • без артикля — вообще, в целом (мн. число или неисчисляемое): Films can educate people. Music helps us relax.

      2. A или an

      Решает звук: an hour, an MBA, an honest man (h не читается, M читается «эм»); a university, a European country, a one-way ticket (звучит «ю», «й», «у»).

      3. Когда нужен the

      • Уже упоминалось или понятно из ситуации: Close the door, please.
      • Единственное в своём роде: the sun, the internet, the environment, the government, the world.
      • Превосходная степень и порядковые: the highest figure, the first year, the same, the only.
      • С of-уточнением: the number of students, the proportion of women, the development of technology.
      • Инструменты и группы людей: play the piano; the elderly, the rich, the unemployed.
      • Десятилетия и периоды: in the 1990s.

      4. Нулевой артикль

      • Обобщение во множественном числе: Children need love. (не The children need love, если о детях вообще).
      • Неисчисляемые в общем смысле: Education is important. Pollution is a serious problem.
      • Приёмы пищи, языки, предметы, виды спорта: have lunch, speak French, study maths, play football.
      • Годы, месяцы, дни: in 2020, on Monday.

      ✗ The education is the key to the success. ✓ Education is the key to success.

      ✗ The technology has changed our lives. (вообще) ✓ Technology has changed our lives.

      ✗ Number of tourists increased. ✓ The number of tourists increased.

      ✗ It is a most important problem. ✓ It is the most important problem.

      5. Названия

      С theБез артикля
      страны-«союзы» и мн. ч.: the UK, the USA, the Netherlands, the Philippinesбольшинство стран: Japan, France, Uzbekistan
      реки, моря, океаны, пустыни, горные цепи: the Thames, the Pacific, the Sahara, the Alpsотдельные горы и озёра: Everest, Lake Baikal
      музеи, отели, театры, газеты: the British Museum, the Guardianулицы, парки, аэропорты, университеты «Name + University»: Oxford Street, Hyde Park, Heathrow, Oxford University
      the University of Oxford (с of)континенты, города: Asia, Tashkent

      6. Устойчивые выражения

      • Без артикля, когда речь о назначении места: go to school / university / bed / work / prison / hospital (как пациент), at home, by car / bus, on foot.
      • Но the school — о здании: My mother went to the school to speak to the teacher.
      • in the morning / afternoon / evening, но at night; in the future, at the moment, on the other hand, in the end.
      IELTS в Task 1 почти всегда the number of / the proportion of / the percentage of / the figure for / the highest / the USA / the UK, а в Task 2 обобщения идут без артикля: Governments should invest in education.

      Практика 1. A / an / the / —

      Этап 1 — база · тема 5

      5. Nouns & Plurals

      Исчисляемые и неисчисляемые, неправильные множественные формы, much/many, согласование с глаголом

      План урока

      Цель: Не путать исчисляемые и неисчисляемые существительные (advice, information, research), правильно образовывать множественное число и согласовывать подлежащее со сказуемым — включая коварные the number of и a number of.

      1. Правила множественного числа и неправильные формы.
      2. Неисчисляемые существительные, которые в русском исчисляемые.
      3. Как «посчитать» неисчисляемое: a piece of, an item of.
      4. Much / many, few / little, a lot of, a number of / an amount of.
      5. Согласование: the number of, everyone, news, people, police.
      6. Практика 1–4 и тест по теме.

      Практика: 38 заданий в 4 блоках · тест: 15 вопросов

      Теория

      1. Множественное число

      ПравилоПример
      + strend → trends
      -s, -sh, -ch, -x, -o → + esbus → buses, potato → potatoes (но photos, pianos)
      согласная + y → iescity → cities (но day → days)
      -f / -fe → veslife → lives, half → halves (но roofs, beliefs)
      неправильныеman → men, woman → women, child → children, person → people, foot → feet, tooth → teeth, mouse → mice
      не меняютсяsheep, fish, species, series, means, aircraft
      латинские и греческие (академические)phenomenon → phenomena, criterion → criteria, analysis → analyses, crisis → crises, datum → data, medium → media

      2. Неисчисляемые — без a/an и без -s

      Самые частые ловушки для русскоязычных: advice, information, research, knowledge, evidence, equipment, furniture, luggage, baggage, traffic, accommodation, homework, news, progress, work (работа), travel (путешествия вообще), money, damage, pollution, transport, software, feedback, scenery.

      ✗ She gave me a good advice. ✓ She gave me some good advice / a piece of advice.

      ✗ We need more informations. ✓ We need more information.

      ✗ Scientists have done many researches. ✓ Scientists have done a lot of research / many studies.

      ✗ The news are bad. ✓ The news is bad.

      3. Как посчитать

      a piece of advice / information / furniture / evidence, an item of news / clothing, a sheet of paper, a bar of chocolate, a loaf of bread, a means of transport.

      Некоторые слова меняют смысл: a paper (газета, статья) — paper (бумага); a glass (стакан) — glass (стекло); a work of art — work; an experience (случай) — experience (опыт).

      4. Слова количества

      С исчисляемыми (мн. ч.)С неисчисляемымиС обоими
      many, few, a few, a number of, severalmuch, little, a little, an amount of, a great deal ofa lot of, lots of, some, any, plenty of, more, most
      • few / little = мало (негативно); a few / a little = несколько, немного (позитивно).
      • fewer (исчисляемые) / less (неисчисляемые): fewer cars, less traffic.
      • the number of + мн. ч. → глагол в ед. ч.: The number of students has increased.
      • a number of (= несколько) + мн. ч. → глагол во мн. ч.: A number of students have complained.

      5. Согласование с глаголом

      • people, police, cattle — всегда мн. ч.: People are…, The police have arrested…
      • news, mathematics, economics, physics — ед. ч.: Economics is difficult.
      • everyone, everybody, each, every + ед. ч.: Every student has…
      • data: в академическом стиле часто мн. ч. (the data show), в современном — ед. ч. (the data shows); на экзамене подходят оба.
      • Подлежащее стоит до of: The quality of the products has improved.
      IELTS в Task 1 — the number of (исчисляемые: people, cars) vs the amount of (неисчисляемые: water, money, energy). ✗ the amount of tourists → ✓ the number of tourists. В Task 2 особенно часто ошибаются в research, advice, knowledge, equipment, evidence.

      Этап 1 — база · тема 6

      6. Adjectives & Adverbs

      Прилагательное или наречие, -ed/-ing, порядок прилагательных, so/such, too/enough, hard/hardly

      План урока

      Цель: Правильно выбирать между прилагательным и наречием, различать bored и boring, ставить несколько прилагательных в правильном порядке и точно описывать степень (very, extremely, slightly) — это основа языка Task 1.

      1. Прилагательное описывает существительное, наречие — глагол, прилагательное, предложение.
      2. Глаголы-связки: look, seem, feel, sound, become + прилагательное.
      3. -ed (что чувствую) и -ing (что вызывает чувство).
      4. Образование наречий и исключения: fast, hard, late, well.
      5. Порядок прилагательных; so / such; too / enough.
      6. Слова степени для Task 1: slightly, significantly, dramatically.
      7. Практика 1–4 и тест по теме.

      Практика: 36 заданий в 4 блоках · тест: 15 вопросов

      Теория

      1. Кого описываем?

      ПрилагательноеНаречие
      a rapid increaseincreased rapidly
      a careful driverdrives carefully
      The test was easy.She passed easily.
      —extremely important (наречие перед прилагательным)
      —Unfortunately, the plan failed. (всё предложение)

      2. Глаголы-связки + прилагательное

      После be, become, get, seem, appear, look, sound, feel, taste, smell, remain, stay описываем подлежащее, поэтому нужно прилагательное:

      ✗ You look tiredly. ✓ You look tired.

      ✗ The figure remained stably. ✓ The figure remained stable.

      ✗ It sounds greatly. ✓ It sounds great.

      3. -ed и -ing

      • -ed — что человек чувствует: I am bored / interested / surprised / confused.
      • -ing — что вызывает чувство: The lecture was boring / interesting / surprising / confusing.

      ✗ I am very interesting in history. ✓ I am very interested in history.

      ✗ The results were disappointed. ✓ The results were disappointing.

      4. Наречия: образование и исключения

      • обычно + -ly: slow → slowly; -y → -ily: easy → easily; -le → -ly: gentle → gently; -ic → -ically: dramatic → dramatically (но public → publicly).
      • good → well: She speaks English well. (well = здоров — прилагательное: I feel well).
      • Одинаковые формы: fast, hard, late, early, high, low, straight: He works hard. The train arrived late.
      • Ловушки: hardly = едва, почти не (I could hardly hear); lately = в последнее время; highly = очень (highly unlikely); nearly = почти.
      • Прилагательные на -ly (friendly, lovely, lonely, likely, costly) — наречия от них нет: in a friendly way.

      5. Порядок нескольких прилагательных

      мнение → размер → возраст → форма → цвет → происхождение → материал → назначение + существительное: a beautiful old Italian car; a small round wooden table.

      6. so / such, too / enough

      • so + прилагательное / наречие: It was so cold. — such (a) + (прил.) + существительное: It was such a cold day. They are such nice people.
      • too + прил. = слишком (плохо): It's too expensive to buy.
      • прил. + enough: He isn't old enough to drive. — enough + существительное: enough money.

      7. Слова степени для Task 1

      Небольшое изменениеЗаметноеОчень сильное
      slightly, marginally, a littlesignificantly, considerably, substantially, noticeablydramatically, sharply, rapidly, steeply

      Сравни: a slight fall = fell slightly; a dramatic rise = rose dramatically.

      IELTS чередуй «прилагательное + существительное» и «глагол + наречие» и не повторяй одно и то же слово степени больше двух раз за ответ. Модели remain + прилагательное (remained stable / unchanged / constant) — одни из самых частых в Task 1.

      Этап 1 — база · тема 7

      7. Prepositions

      Время, место, движение, зависимые предлоги и предлоги графиков Task 1 (rise by / to, an increase in)

      План урока

      Цель: Точно использовать предлоги времени и места, знать самые частые сочетания «глагол / прилагательное / существительное + предлог» и не путать by и to в описании изменений на графиках.

      1. Время: at / on / in; for / since / during; by / until.
      2. Место: at / on / in; движение: to / into / towards.
      3. Зависимые предлоги после глаголов, прилагательных и существительных.
      4. Предлоги в Task 1: rise to / by / from … to, an increase in / of.
      5. Предлог + -ing.
      6. Практика 1–5 и тест по теме.

      Практика: 43 заданий в 5 блоках · тест: 15 вопросов

      Теория

      1. Время

      atonin
      точное время, праздники, «точки»: at 6 pm, at night, at the weekend (BrE), at Christmas, at the end ofдни и даты: on Monday, on 5 May, on my birthday, on Monday morningмесяцы, годы, века, части дня, периоды: in May, in 2020, in the 1990s, in the morning, in summer
      • for + отрезок (сколько): for three years; since + начало (с какого момента): since 2015.
      • during + существительное (во время чего): during the war; while + предложение: while I was studying.
      • by = не позже: by 2030, by Friday; until = вплоть до (действие длится): wait until 5 pm.
      • in time = вовремя (с запасом), on time = точно по расписанию.
      • Без предлога: last year, next week, this morning, every day.

      ✗ in Monday ✓ on Monday ✗ during three years → ✓ for three years ✗ since three years → ✓ for three years

      2. Место и движение

      • at — точка: at the station, at home, at work, at the bus stop.
      • on — поверхность, линия: on the wall, on the third floor, on the coast, on the river (город на реке).
      • in — внутри, территории: in the room, in London, in Asia, in the north of the country.
      • Движение: to (куда), into (внутрь), out of, towards (по направлению), through, across, along.
      • arrive at (здание, место) / arrive in (город, страна); get to; но go home (без to).

      3. Зависимые предлоги (выучить как слова)

      Глагол + предлогПрилагательное + предлогСуществительное + предлог
      depend on, rely on, focus on, spend money oninterested in, good at, responsible for, aware ofan increase in, a decrease in, a rise in
      apply for, pay for, account forafraid of, proud of, capable ofa solution to, the answer to, access to
      belong to, contribute to, lead tosimilar to, related to, addicted tothe reason for, the demand for, a need for
      suffer from, benefit from, protect fromdifferent from, famous foran impact on, an effect on, an influence on
      consist of, approve of, take care ofkeen on, dependent ona cause of, a lack of, an advantage of

      ✗ It depends of the weather. ✓ It depends on the weather.

      ✗ We discussed about the problem. ✓ We discussed the problem.

      ✗ The solution of this problem… ✓ The solution to this problem…

      ✗ Technology has a big influence to children. ✓ Technology has a big influence on children.

      4. Предлоги графиков (Task 1)

      • rose to 50% — до какого уровня; rose by 10% — на сколько; rose from 40% to 50%.
      • an increase / a rise / a fall in sales — в чём; an increase of 10% — величина.
      • at its peak, at 20% (stood at 20%), with 20% (Japan came second, with 20%).
      • between 2000 and 2010, from 2000 to 2010, over the period, in the first year.
      • the figure for France, the proportion of women.

      ✗ Sales increased with 20%. ✓ Sales increased by 20%.

      ✗ There was a rise of unemployment. ✓ There was a rise in unemployment.

      5. Предлог + -ing

      После предлога глагол стоит в форме -ing: interested in learning, good at solving, instead of driving, before leaving, by using. И look forward to + -ing: I look forward to hearing from you.

      IELTS в письмах GT финальная фраза I look forward to hearing from you (не to hear). В Task 1 путаница by / to меняет смысл цифр и снижает оценку за Task Achievement.

      Этап 2 — основные конструкции · тема 8

      8. Present Tenses

      Present Simple, Present Continuous, глаголы состояния; Present Perfect и Perfect Continuous — основы

      План урока

      Цель: Выбирать настоящее время по смыслу: постоянное или временное, факт или процесс, результат к настоящему моменту. Это нужно и для Speaking Part 1 (о себе), и для Task 1 без дат.

      1. Present Simple: факты, привычки, расписания; окончание -s.
      2. Present Continuous: сейчас, временно, тенденции (is increasing).
      3. Глаголы состояния, которые не ставят в -ing.
      4. Present Perfect: опыт, результат, незаконченный период (основы; подробно в теме 14).
      5. Present Perfect Continuous: как долго длится процесс.
      6. Практика 1–5 и тест по теме.

      Практика: 38 заданий в 5 блоках · тест: 15 вопросов

      Теория

      1. Present Simple

      Форма: I/you/we/they work; he/she/it works. Вопрос и отрицание — с do / does: Does she work? She doesn't work.

      • Факты и общие истины: Water boils at 100°C. The table shows the number of…
      • Привычки и регулярность (always, usually, every day): I usually walk to work.
      • Расписания: The train leaves at 7.
      • Окончание -s в 3-м лице: -es после s, sh, ch, x, o (goes, watches); согласная + y → -ies (studies).

      ✗ She work in a bank. ✓ She works in a bank.

      ✗ Does he likes coffee? ✓ Does he like coffee?

      2. Present Continuous

      Форма: am / is / are + V-ing.

      • Происходит сейчас: I'm reading right now.
      • Временная ситуация: She is living with her parents this year.
      • Изменения и тенденции: The climate is getting warmer. More people are working from home.
      • Раздражающая привычка с always: He's always losing his keys!
      • Планы на будущее (подробно в теме 10): I'm meeting him tomorrow.
      Present SimplePresent Continuous
      I live in Tashkent. (постоянно)I'm living in a hostel this month. (временно)
      She teaches maths. (профессия)She's teaching a class now. (сейчас)
      The population grows every year. (факт)The population is growing fast. (тенденция сейчас)

      3. Глаголы состояния (stative verbs)

      Обычно не используются в Continuous: know, believe, understand, mean, want, need, prefer, like, love, hate, own, belong, seem, consist, contain, depend, matter, cost.

      ✗ I am knowing the answer. ✓ I know the answer.

      ✗ This bag is belonging to me. ✓ This bag belongs to me.

      Некоторые меняют смысл: I think it's a good idea (мнение) — I'm thinking about it (процесс). She has a car (владеет) — She's having lunch (действие). The soup tastes good — The chef is tasting the soup.

      4. Present Perfect — основы

      Форма: have / has + V3. Связывает прошлое с настоящим:

      • опыт (ever, never): I've never been to Japan.
      • результат сейчас: I've lost my keys (и их нет).
      • незаконченный период (for, since, this year): She's lived here since 2015.
      • новости (just, already, yet): They've just opened a new metro line.

      5. Present Perfect Continuous

      Форма: have / has been + V-ing. Процесс, который длится до сих пор или только что закончился: I've been studying English for three years. You look tired — have you been running?

      Сравни: I've read three books this month (результат, сколько) — I've been reading all afternoon (процесс, как долго).

      IELTS в Speaking Part 1 о себе — Present Simple (I work as…, I usually…); о текущих изменениях — Present Continuous (These days I'm trying to…); об опыте — Present Perfect (I've always been interested in…). В Task 1 без дат и в процессах — только Present Simple.

      Практика 1. Simple или Continuous?

      Практика 3. Впиши глагол в нужной форме (Present Simple / Continuous)

      Этап 2 — основные конструкции · тема 9

      9. Past Tenses

      Past Simple, неправильные глаголы, Past Continuous, Past Perfect, used to и would

      План урока

      Цель: Рассказывать о прошлом последовательно и точно: что произошло, что в это время происходило, что случилось ещё раньше. Это основа Task 1 с прошлыми датами и рассказов в Speaking Part 2.

      1. Past Simple: правильные и неправильные глаголы, did в вопросах.
      2. Past Continuous: фон и прерванное действие (when / while).
      3. Past Perfect: «предпрошедшее» (by 2010, before, after).
      4. Used to и would для прошлых привычек.
      5. Past в Task 1: последовательность и время.
      6. Практика 1–5 и тест по теме.

      Практика: 38 заданий в 5 блоках · тест: 15 вопросов

      Теория

      1. Past Simple

      Законченное действие в прошлом, часто с указанием времени: yesterday, in 2010, two years ago, last month.

      • Правильные: -ed (worked, studied, stopped); неправильные надо выучить: go → went, rise → rose, fall → fell, grow → grew, begin → began, buy → bought, think → thought, teach → taught, spend → spent, lead → led.
      • Вопрос и отрицание с did + инфинитив: Did prices rise? Prices didn't rise.

      ✗ Did you went there? ✓ Did you go there?

      ✗ The number of visitors raised. ✓ The number of visitors rose. (raise — поднимать что-то, нужен объект)

      2. Past Continuous

      was / were + V-ing — процесс в определённый момент прошлого, фон истории.

      • At 8 pm yesterday I was watching TV.
      • Длинное действие прерывается коротким: I was walking home when it started to rain.
      • Два параллельных процесса: While I was cooking, my brother was studying.
      when + короткое действие (Past Simple)while + длительное действие (Past Continuous)
      I was having a shower when the phone rang.While I was having a shower, the phone rang.

      3. Past Perfect

      had + V3 — действие произошло раньше другого прошлого действия или к моменту в прошлом.

      • When I arrived, the film had already started. (сначала начался фильм)
      • By 2010, the population had doubled. (к 2010 году)
      • После after, before, by the time, already, never … before.

      Сравни: When I arrived, the film started (начался при мне) — When I arrived, the film had started (уже шёл).

      4. Used to и would

      • used to + инфинитив — прошлые привычки и состояния, которых больше нет: I used to live in a village. There used to be a cinema here.
      • would — только повторяющиеся действия (не состояния): Every summer we would go to the seaside.
      • Вопрос/отрицание: Did you use to…? I didn't use to…
      • Не путать с be/get used to + -ing (привыкнуть): I'm used to getting up early.

      ✗ I would live in Samarkand as a child. ✓ I used to live in Samarkand as a child.

      5. Прошлое в Task 1

      Все годы в прошлом → Past Simple. Чтобы показать итог к дате — Past Perfect: By 2020, the figure had risen to 45%. Перед этим не нужно Present Perfect: ✗ In 2010 the number has increased → ✓ In 2010 the number increased.

      IELTS в Speaking Part 2 история «Describe a time when…» звучит естественно, если смешивать времена: фон — Past Continuous (I was travelling with friends…), события — Past Simple (we missed the bus), предыстория — Past Perfect (we had never been there before). Это и есть «range» для Band 7.

      Этап 2 — основные конструкции · тема 10

      10. Future Forms

      will, be going to, Present Continuous и Simple для будущего, прогнозы в Task 1, Future Continuous и Perfect

      План урока

      Цель: Выбирать форму будущего по смыслу (решение, план, договорённость, прогноз) и уверенно писать прогнозы в Task 1: is expected to, is predicted to, is likely to, will have reached.

      1. Will: решения в момент речи, обещания, предсказания-мнения.
      2. Be going to: планы и прогнозы по признакам.
      3. Present Continuous и Present Simple для будущего.
      4. Будущее после when, if, as soon as — без will.
      5. Future Continuous и Future Perfect.
      6. Язык прогнозов для Task 1.
      7. Практика 1–5 и тест по теме.

      Практика: 33 заданий в 5 блоках · тест: 15 вопросов

      Теория

      1. Основные формы

      ФормаКогдаПример
      willрешение прямо сейчас; обещание, предложение; мнение о будущем (think, probably)I'll help you. I think prices will rise.
      be going toплан, принятый заранее; прогноз по видимым признакамI'm going to study medicine. Look at the clouds — it's going to rain.
      Present Continuousдоговорённость с конкретным временемI'm meeting the director at 10 tomorrow.
      Present Simpleрасписание, программаThe conference starts on Monday.

      2. Время и условие — без will

      После when, if, as soon as, before, after, until, unless, by the time про будущее используем Present Simple (или Present Perfect):

      ✗ I'll call you when I will arrive. ✓ I'll call you when I arrive.

      ✗ If it will rain, we will stay at home. ✓ If it rains, we will stay at home.

      3. Future Continuous и Future Perfect

      • will be + V-ing — процесс в момент будущего: This time tomorrow I'll be flying to London.
      • will have + V3 — завершится к моменту в будущем: By 2030, the city will have built three new metro lines.
      • will have been + V-ing — как долго к моменту: By June I'll have been working here for five years.

      4. Прогнозы в Task 1

      Активная конструкцияБезличная / пассивная
      The number will rise to 10 million.The number is expected / predicted / projected / forecast to rise to 10 million.
      Japan will probably overtake Germany.It is predicted that Japan will overtake Germany.
      The figure is likely to stabilise.The figure is set to fall.
      By 2050, the figure will have doubled.—

      Прошлое на том же графике — Past Simple, прогноз — эти конструкции. Не пиши will в каждом предложении: чередуй.

      IELTS в Task 2 will помогает показать последствия (This will lead to…), а модальные may, might, could делают утверждения осторожными (This could result in…) — экзаменатор ценит такую «hedging»-лексику (подробно в теме 12).

      Практика 1. Will или be going to?

      Этап 2 — основные конструкции · тема 11

      11. Questions & Negatives

      Вопросы во всех временах, вопросы к подлежащему, косвенные вопросы, tag questions, отрицания

      План урока

      Цель: Задавать любые вопросы без ошибок порядка слов, использовать вежливые косвенные вопросы (в письмах GT и в Speaking) и правильно строить отрицания.

      1. Порядок слов в вопросе: вспомогательный глагол + подлежащее + глагол.
      2. Вопросы к подлежащему: Who called? — без do.
      3. Вопросы с предлогом в конце: What are you looking at?
      4. Косвенные вопросы: Could you tell me where the station is?
      5. Tag questions: isn't it? didn't you?
      6. Отрицания: not, no, never, neither / nor, одно отрицание на предложение.
      7. Практика 1–5 и тест по теме.

      Практика: 34 заданий в 5 блоках · тест: 15 вопросов

      Теория

      1. Схема вопроса

      (Вопросительное слово) + вспомогательный глагол + подлежащее + основной глагол

      ВремяВспомогательныйПример
      Present Simpledo / doesWhere does she work?
      Past SimpledidWhen did the prices rise?
      beam / is / are / was / wereAre you ready? Why was he late?
      ContinuousbeWhat are you doing?
      Perfecthave / has / hadHave you ever been to Spain?
      Modalcan / will / should…How can we solve this problem?

      ✗ Where you live? ✓ Where do you live?

      ✗ Why she is crying? ✓ Why is she crying?

      ✗ What did you said? ✓ What did you say?

      2. Вопросы к подлежащему

      Если вопросительное слово (who, what, which, how many) само является подлежащим, do/does/did не нужно, порядок прямой:

      • Who called you? (кто-то позвонил) — сравни Who did you call? (ты позвонил кому-то)
      • What happened? (не What did happen?)
      • How many people came?

      3. Предлог в конце

      В разговорном и нейтральном английском предлог остаётся в конце: What are you talking about? Who did you go with? Where do you come from? Формально: With whom did you go?

      4. Косвенные вопросы

      После вежливого начала порядок слов становится прямым, do/does/did исчезают:

      Прямой вопросКосвенный
      Where is the station?Could you tell me where the station is?
      What time does the museum open?Do you know what time the museum opens?
      Did he pass the exam?I wonder if / whether he passed the exam.

      ✗ Could you tell me where is the bank? ✓ Could you tell me where the bank is?

      ✗ I'd like to know when does the course start. ✓ I'd like to know when the course starts.

      5. Tag questions (…, не так ли?)

      Утверждение → отрицательный «хвост», отрицание → положительный. Вспомогательный глагол берём из предложения: It's cold, isn't it? You live here, don't you? She didn't call, did she? You've finished, haven't you? Особые: I'm right, aren't I? Let's go, shall we? Nobody came, did they?

      6. Отрицания

      • not с вспомогательным: don't, didn't, haven't, won't, can't.
      • no + существительное = not any: There is no time = There isn't any time.
      • Одно отрицание в предложении: ✗ I didn't see nobody → ✓ I didn't see anybody / I saw nobody.
      • neither / nor / either: I don't like it, and neither does my sister. — "I can't swim." — "Nor can I / I can't either."
      • Отрицание с think, believe, expect обычно ставится в главную часть: I don't think it's true (а не I think it isn't true — тоже возможно, но звучит резче).
      • Отрицательные вопросы — удивление: Don't you know him?
      IELTS в письмах GT используй косвенные вопросы: I would be grateful if you could tell me whether the price includes breakfast. В Speaking уточняющие вопросы экзаменатору тоже косвенные: Could you explain what you mean by…?

      Этап 2 — основные конструкции · тема 12

      12. Modal Verbs

      can, could, may, might, must, have to, should, ought to, need: возможность, обязанность, совет, вероятность и осторожные формулировки

      План урока

      Цель: Точно выражать обязанность, совет, возможность и степень уверенности. Модальные глаголы — главный инструмент «hedging» (осторожных утверждений) в Task 2: This could lead to… / Governments should…

      1. Грамматика модальных: без -s, без to, без do.
      2. Способность: can, could, be able to.
      3. Обязанность и необходимость: must, have to, need to; отсутствие необходимости: don't have to, needn't.
      4. Запрет: mustn't, can't.
      5. Совет: should, ought to, had better.
      6. Вероятность: must, may, might, could, can't.
      7. Hedging в Task 2.
      8. Практика 1–5 и тест по теме.

      Практика: 32 заданий в 5 блоках · тест: 15 вопросов

      Теория

      1. Грамматика

      Модальный глагол + инфинитив без to; нет окончания -s; вопросы и отрицания без do: She can swim. Can she swim? She can't swim. Исключения со to: have to, need to, ought to, be able to.

      ✗ She cans drive. ✓ She can drive.

      ✗ You should to study. ✓ You should study.

      ✗ Do you can help me? ✓ Can you help me?

      2. Способность

      • can / can't — сейчас; could / couldn't — вообще в прошлом: I could read when I was four.
      • was able to / managed to — смог в конкретной ситуации в прошлом: The fire spread quickly, but everyone was able to escape. (не could escape)
      • Будущее и после других глаголов — be able to: I will be able to help you tomorrow. I'd like to be able to speak Chinese.

      3. Обязанность и необходимость

      ЗначениеПример
      mustобязанность по мнению говорящего, правила на письмеI must call my mother. Passengers must wear seat belts.
      have toобязанность из-за внешних обстоятельств; все временаI have to wear a uniform at work. We had to wait.
      need toнеобходимостьYou need to renew your visa.
      don't have to / don't need to / needn'tнет необходимости (можно, но не обязательно)You don't have to come if you're busy.
      mustn'tзапретYou mustn't smoke here.

      mustn't ≠ don't have to: You mustn't tell anyone (нельзя) — You don't have to tell anyone (не обязательно).

      В прошлом must → had to: ✗ I must go yesterday → ✓ I had to go yesterday.

      4. Совет и рекомендация

      • should / ought to — совет, мнение: Governments should invest in public transport.
      • had better (not) — совет с предупреждением: You'd better leave now, or you'll miss the train.
      • shouldn't have + V3 — сожаление о прошлом (см. тему 24): I shouldn't have eaten so much.

      5. Вероятность и логические выводы

      УверенностьМодальныйПример
      ≈ 100% «наверняка»mustHe's been working all day — he must be tired.
      50% «может быть»may / might / couldIt may rain later. This could be the reason.
      ≈ 0% «не может быть»can't / couldn'tThat can't be true! (не mustn't be)

      О прошлом: must have / might have / can't have + V3 (подробно в теме 24).

      6. Hedging — осторожные утверждения в Task 2

      Категоричные утверждения (Video games make children violent) легко опровергнуть. Band 7–9 звучит взвешенно:

      Video games may contribute to aggressive behaviour in some children.

      This policy could lead to higher unemployment.

      Stricter laws might help to reduce crime.

      Governments should consider…

      Сочетания: may well (вполне вероятно), could potentially, is likely to, tend to.

      IELTS не перебарщивай — если каждое предложение с may, эссе звучит неуверенно. Свою позицию формулируй уверенно (I believe that… should…), а прогнозы и причины — осторожно (This may lead to…).

      Практика 1. Обязанность, отсутствие необходимости, запрет

      Этап 2 — основные конструкции · тема 13

      13. Comparatives & Superlatives

      Сравнительная и превосходная степень, as…as, twice as many as, the more…the more, much/far/slightly + comparative

      План урока

      Цель: Сравнивать точно и разнообразно — главный навык Task 1 («make comparisons where relevant») и полезный приём в Task 2. Знать формы, усилители и конструкции с кратностью.

      1. Образование: -er/-est и more/most; неправильные формы.
      2. Сравнение двух: than; равенство: as … as, not as … as.
      3. Усилители и смягчители: much, far, considerably, slightly, a little.
      4. Кратность: twice as high as, three times more than, half as many as.
      5. The more…, the more…; comparative and comparative.
      6. Превосходная: the … of / in, one of the + мн. ч., the second largest.
      7. Практика 1–5 и тест по теме.

      Практика: 36 заданий в 5 блоках · тест: 15 вопросов

      Теория

      1. Формы

      ПрилагательноеСравнительнаяПревосходная
      1 слог: cheap, highcheaper, higherthe cheapest, the highest
      -e: largelargerthe largest
      гласная + согласная: big, hotbigger, hotterthe biggest
      -y: easy, busyeasier, busierthe easiest
      2+ слога: modern, expensivemore modern, more expensivethe most expensive
      неправильныеgood → better, bad → worse, far → further/farther, many/much → more, little → lessthe best, the worst, the furthest, the most, the least

      Наречия: quickly → more quickly; fast → faster; well → better; badly → worse.

      ✗ more cheaper ✓ cheaper ✗ the most biggest → ✓ the biggest ✗ more good → ✓ better

      2. Than и as … as

      • Rents in London are higher than in Manchester.
      • Равенство: The figure for 2010 was as high as in 2000.
      • Неравенство: Trains are not as fast as planes. (= planes are faster)
      • После than / as — объектное местоимение или полное предложение: She is taller than me / than I am.
      • Сравни правильные вещи: ✗ The population of Tokyo is larger than Paris → ✓ …larger than that of Paris / …than Paris's.

      3. Степень разницы

      Большая разницаНебольшая разница
      much / far / considerably / significantly / substantially higherslightly / a little / marginally / a bit higher

      ✗ very higher ✓ much higher ✗ more higher → ✓ much higher

      4. Кратность (Task 1!)

      • twice as many tourists as, three times as high as, half as much as
      • twice / three times the number of: Japan had twice the number of visitors that Spain had.
      • The figure doubled / tripled / halved.
      • X was three times higher than Y — разговорно допустимо, но three times as high as точнее.

      5. Двойное сравнение и рост

      • The more you practise, the better you become. The higher the price, the fewer people buy it.
      • Постепенное изменение: It's getting colder and colder. Life is becoming more and more expensive.

      6. Превосходная степень

      • the highest in the world / in the group, the most popular of the five activities.
      • one of the most important problems (мн. ч.!).
      • the second largest, the third most popular.
      • the least popular = самый непопулярный.
      • С Present Perfect: the best film I have ever seen.
      IELTS в Task 1 сравнение не «украшение», а требование. Чередуй: higher than, the highest, twice as many as, slightly lower, the second most popular, by contrast, while. Ошибка more higher или the most biggest сразу показывает уровень ниже 6.

      Практика 1. Образуй нужную форму

      Впиши правильную форму или слово. Подсказка — в скобках.

      3 Today is (hot) than yesterday. ✔ hotter

      5 The situation is getting (bad). ✔ worse

      8 He drives (carefully) than his brother. ✔ more carefully
      9 Walking is (healthy) than driving. ✔ healthier

      Выбери правильный вариант.

      1 The new phone is ____ more powerful than the old one.
      • A very
      • B much

       ✔ B much
      2 Rents in the city are ____ higher than in the countryside.

      • A as fast as
      • B as faster as

       ✔ A as fast as

      • A considerably
      • B slightly
      • C much

      Практика 3. Кратность и двойное сравнение

      Этап 3 — средний уровень · тема 14

      14. Present Perfect vs Past Simple

      Связь с настоящим или законченное прошлое: маркеры времени, for/since, «опыт», новости, Task 1 и Speaking

      План урока

      Цель: Безошибочно выбирать между Present Perfect и Past Simple по смыслу и маркерам времени, знать «серые зоны» (this morning, just, British vs American) и правильно использовать оба времени в Task 1, Task 2 и Speaking.

      1. Главный критерий: указано ли законченное время в прошлом?
      2. Маркеры Past Simple и маркеры Present Perfect.
      3. Опыт (ever / never) и конкретный случай (when?).
      4. Незаконченный период: for, since, this week, so far.
      5. Результат, новости, just / already / yet.
      6. Present Perfect Continuous против Present Perfect Simple.
      7. Сложные случаи: this morning, «it's the first time», since + Past Simple.
      8. Как это выглядит в Task 1, Task 2 и Speaking.
      9. Практика 1–6 и тест по теме.

      Практика: 46 заданий в 6 блоках · тест: 20 вопросов

      Теория

      1. Главное правило

      Past Simple — действие в законченном периоде прошлого, связь с «сейчас» не важна. Present Perfect — период ещё не закончен или важен результат / опыт сейчас, а точное время не называется.

      Past SimplePresent Perfect
      I lost my keys yesterday. (история)I've lost my keys. (их нет сейчас)
      She lived in Rome for five years. (больше не живёт)She's lived in Rome for five years. (живёт до сих пор)
      Did you see the match last night?Have you seen the new film? (вообще, уже)
      Shakespeare wrote 39 plays. (умер)This author has written ten novels. (жив, может написать ещё)

      2. Маркеры

      Только Past SimpleОбычно Present Perfect
      yesterday, last week/year, ago, in 2010, when I was a child, at 5 o'clock, then, the other dayever, never, just, already, yet, so far, up to now, recently, lately, since…, for… (до сих пор), this week/month/year, today (не закончился), how long…?

      ✗ I have seen him two days ago. ✓ I saw him two days ago.

      ✗ When have you arrived? ✓ When did you arrive?

      ✗ I live here since 2015. ✓ I have lived here since 2015.

      ✗ In 2010 the company has opened a new factory. ✓ In 2010 the company opened a new factory.

      3. Опыт и конкретный случай

      Вопрос об опыте — Present Perfect; как только разговор переходит к деталям (когда? где? как?) — Past Simple:

      "Have you ever been to Turkey?" — "Yes, I have. I went there last summer. It was amazing."

      4. Незаконченный период и for / since

      • for + длительность, since + точка начала: for three years, since 2020, since I was a child.
      • После since в придаточном — Past Simple: I've known her since we were at school.
      • It's (been) five years since I last saw him.
      • this week / this year / today: если период не закончился — Present Perfect (I've drunk three coffees today); если говоришь о закончившейся части — Past Simple (I drank too much coffee this morning — сказано днём, утро закончилось).

      5. Новости, результат, just / already / yet

      • Новость вводится Present Perfect, детали — Past Simple: A strong earthquake has hit Japan. It struck at 6 am local time.
      • just, already — в утверждениях; yet — в вопросах и отрицаниях в конце: Have you finished yet? I haven't finished yet.
      • В американском английском с just/already/yet часто Past Simple (Did you eat yet?), в британском и на IELTS безопаснее Present Perfect.

      6. Present Perfect Simple vs Continuous

      Simple — результат, количествоContinuous — процесс, длительность
      I've written three emails.I've been writing emails all morning.
      She's painted the room. (готово)She's been painting the room. (может быть, не закончила; руки в краске)
      Глаголы состояния: I've known him for years.✗ I've been knowing him

      7. Особые конструкции

      • It's the first / second time I've been here. (не I am here)
      • This is the best film I've ever seen.
      • I haven't seen him for ages / since Monday.
      • Have you ever…? — No, never. / Yes, once.

      Как это использовать на IELTS

      Task 1

      • Все даты в прошлом (1990–2020) → только Past Simple (rose, fell, peaked). Present Perfect здесь ошибка.
      • Если график доходит до «сейчас» и описываешь изменения до настоящего момента (редко), возможно has risen since 2010. Безопасное правило: есть конкретные прошлые годы — Past Simple.

      Task 2

      • Present Perfect — для тенденций, которые продолжаются: In recent years, the internet has transformed the way we work. The number of people living alone has risen considerably.
      • Past Simple — для конкретных прошлых примеров: When my city introduced a bike-sharing scheme in 2018, car traffic fell.

      Speaking

      • Part 1 «Have you ever…?» → начни с Present Perfect, продолжи Past Simple с деталями.
      • Part 2 «Describe a place you have visited» → в вопросе Present Perfect, но рассказ — Past Simple: I visited Samarkand two years ago…
      • Part 3 о переменах: Technology has changed education a lot. Twenty years ago, students used textbooks; now…

      Этап 3 — средний уровень · тема 15

      15. Gerund & Infinitive

      -ing или to + инфинитив: глаголы, прилагательные, предлоги; stop/remember/try с разным смыслом; let/make; герундий как подлежащее

      План урока

      Цель: Автоматически выбирать форму второго глагола (enjoy doing, decide to do, make someone do) и понимать, как меняется смысл после stop, remember, forget, try, regret, mean, go on. Использовать герундий-подлежащее для «академичного» стиля Task 2.

      1. Глаголы + -ing.
      2. Глаголы + to-infinitive.
      3. Глагол + объект + to-infinitive (want someone to do).
      4. Инфинитив без to: make, let, help, модальные; see / hear someone do / doing.
      5. Глаголы с изменением смысла: stop, remember, forget, try, regret, mean, go on, need.
      6. После предлогов — всегда -ing (включая look forward to, be used to, object to).
      7. Прилагательные + to: easy to, difficult to; it is + adj + to.
      8. Герундий как подлежащее и инфинитив цели (in order to).
      9. Практика 1–6 и тест по теме.

      Практика: 56 заданий в 6 блоках · тест: 20 вопросов

      Теория

      1. Глагол + -ing

      enjoy, finish, avoid, mind, miss, suggest, recommend, consider, deny, admit, imagine, keep, practise, risk, involve, can't stand, can't help, give up, put off, carry on, look forward to, be worth, it's no use.

      I enjoy reading. They suggested taking a taxi. It's worth visiting the old town.

      ✗ He suggested to go home. ✓ He suggested going home. / He suggested that we (should) go home.

      ✗ I avoid to eat sugar. ✓ I avoid eating sugar.

      2. Глагол + to + инфинитив

      want, would like, decide, plan, hope, expect, agree, refuse, promise, offer, manage, fail, afford, learn, seem, appear, tend, choose, arrange, attempt, threaten, deserve, aim, intend.

      We decided to leave early. Prices tend to rise in winter. Many families can't afford to buy a house.

      3. Глагол + объект + to + инфинитив

      want, would like, expect, ask, tell, advise, allow, encourage, force, persuade, remind, teach, warn, enable, require, invite:

      I want you to help me. Governments should encourage people to use public transport. Technology enables us to work from home.

      ✗ I want that you come. ✓ I want you to come.

      ✗ The law allows to drive at 17. ✓ The law allows people to drive at 17. / The law allows driving at 17.

      4. Без to

      • После модальных: can do, must go, should study.
      • make + объект + V: My parents made me study. (в пассиве с to: I was made to study)
      • let + объект + V: They let us leave early.
      • help (to) + V: This helps (to) reduce costs.
      • had better, would rather: You'd better go.
      • Восприятие: see / hear / watch / notice + объект + V (всё действие) или + V-ing (часть процесса): I saw him cross the road. I saw him crossing the road.

      5. Меняется смысл

      Глагол+ -ing+ to-infinitive
      stopпрекратить: He stopped smoking.остановиться, чтобы: He stopped to smoke.
      rememberпомнить то, что было: I remember meeting her.не забыть сделать: Remember to lock the door.
      forgetзабыть, что было (обычно с never): I'll never forget seeing the ocean.забыть сделать: I forgot to call him.
      tryпопробовать (эксперимент): Try drinking some water.постараться (трудно): I tried to open the window, but it was stuck.
      regretжалеть о сделанном: I regret leaving school early.с сожалением сообщать: We regret to inform you…
      meanозначать, повлечь: A new job means moving to another city.собираться: I meant to call you.
      go onпродолжать то же: She went on talking.перейти к другому: He went on to become president.
      needпассивное значение: The car needs washing.активное: I need to wash the car.

      Глаголы like, love, hate, prefer, start, begin, continue принимают обе формы почти без разницы. Но would like / would love / would prefer + to: I'd like to go.

      6. После предлогов — -ing

      interested in learning, good at solving, instead of driving, by using, without asking, before leaving, after finishing, responsible for organising.

      Ловушка — to как предлог: look forward to seeing, be used to working, get used to living, object to paying, be committed to reducing, contribute to improving, the key to succeeding, when it comes to choosing.

      ✗ I look forward to hear from you. ✓ I look forward to hearing from you.

      ✗ We are committed to reduce emissions. ✓ We are committed to reducing emissions.

      7. Прилагательное + to-infinitive

      It is difficult / important / essential / easy / necessary / possible to find work. English is easy to learn. I was pleased to hear the news. She was the first woman to win the prize.

      8. Герундий-подлежащее и инфинитив цели

      • Подлежащее-действие — герундий: Learning a language takes time. Recycling reduces waste. (глагол в ед. ч.)
      • Цель — to / in order to / so as to: Many people move to cities (in order) to find work. ✗ for find work → ✓ to find work; for + существительное: for work.
      • Отрицательная цель — in order not to / so as not to: We left early so as not to miss the train.

      Как это использовать на IELTS

      Task 2

      • Герундий в начале предложения звучит академично: Banning cars from city centres would reduce pollution. Investing in education benefits everyone.
      • Глагол + объект + to-infinitive — готовые «решения»: Governments should encourage / require / force / allow companies to …; This enables people to …
      • Цель через in order to разнообразит связки: …in order to reduce traffic congestion.

      Writing GT (письма)

      • I look forward to hearing from you. I would appreciate receiving a reply. I am writing to complain about… Would you mind sending me…? I would like to request…

      Speaking

      • Part 1 «Do you like…?» → I really enjoy cooking, but I can't stand washing up. — естественный «range».

      Этап 3 — средний уровень · тема 16

      16. Conditionals

      Zero, First, Second, Third; unless, as long as, provided that, in case; were, could, might в условиях; условия в аргументах Task 2

      План урока

      Цель: Свободно строить все четыре типа условных предложений, выбирать тип по реальности ситуации и использовать условия как инструмент аргументации в Task 2 (If governments invested…, people would…).

      1. Структура: if-часть + главная часть, запятая, порядок частей.
      2. Zero: общие истины.
      3. First: реальное будущее.
      4. Second: нереальное настоящее / маловероятное будущее; were; совет If I were you.
      5. Third: нереальное прошлое, сожаления.
      6. Альтернативы if: unless, as long as, provided (that), on condition that, in case, otherwise, suppose.
      7. Модальные в главной части: might, could, may.
      8. Типичные ошибки русскоязычных.
      9. Практика 1–5 и тест по теме.

      Практика: 39 заданий в 5 блоках · тест: 20 вопросов

      Теория

      1. Четыре типа

      Типif-частьглавная частьСмысл
      ZeroPresent SimplePresent Simpleвсегда так: If you heat ice, it melts.
      FirstPresent Simplewill / can / may + Vреально в будущем: If it rains, we'll stay at home.
      SecondPast Simple (were)would / could / might + Vнереально сейчас / маловероятно: If I had more time, I would learn Chinese.
      ThirdPast Perfectwould / could / might have + V3нереально в прошлом: If I had studied, I would have passed.
      • Если if-часть первая — запятая; если вторая — запятая не нужна: We'll stay at home if it rains.
      • Will / would никогда не ставятся в if-часть (кроме вежливых просьб If you would follow me…).

      ✗ If I will have time, I will call you. ✓ If I have time, I'll call you.

      ✗ If I would be rich, I would travel. ✓ If I were rich, I would travel.

      ✗ If I had known, I would come. ✓ If I had known, I would have come.

      2. First или Second?

      Решает вероятность, а не время: If I win the competition… (я участвую, шанс реален) — If I won the lottery… (почти невозможно). В Task 2 Second conditional делает предложения о политике «гипотетическими» и вежливыми: If the government banned cars from city centres, air quality would improve.

      3. Were и If I were you

      Во Second conditional с I / he / she / it в формальном стиле — were: If she were here, she would know what to do. Совет: If I were you, I'd apply for the job. (was — разговорно, на экзамене лучше were).

      4. Third conditional и сожаления

      • If the government had acted earlier, the crisis could have been avoided.
      • Сокращения: If I'd known (= had), I'd have come (= would have).
      • Сожаление о прошлом: I wish I had studied harder (подробно — тема 26).

      5. Альтернативы if

      СловоСмыслПример
      unlessесли не (= if … not)You won't pass unless you study. (не unless you don't study)
      as long as / provided (that) / providing / on condition thatпри условии, чтоYou can borrow my car as long as you drive carefully.
      in caseна случай, если (мера предосторожности)Take an umbrella in case it rains. (≠ if)
      otherwiseиначеHurry up, otherwise we'll miss the bus.
      suppose / supposing / imagineпредположимSuppose you lost your job, what would you do?
      even ifдаже еслиI'll go even if it rains.

      in case ≠ if: I'll take a map in case I get lost (беру в любом случае) — I'll use the map if I get lost (только если заблужусь).

      6. Модальные и вариации

      • If you should see him, tell him to call me. (если вдруг)
      • If it were to rain, the match would be cancelled. (очень маловероятно; формально)
      • В главной части: might / could / may для меньшей уверенности: If prices rise, demand may fall.
      • Повелительное наклонение: If you see Tom, tell him…

      Как это использовать на IELTS

      Task 2 — условия как аргумент

      • Second conditional для предложений и гипотез: If public transport were free, fewer people would drive to work.
      • Third conditional для примеров из прошлого: If the city had invested in cycle lanes ten years ago, traffic would not have become so bad.
      • Unless и provided that делают позицию точнее: Tourism can benefit local communities, provided that it is carefully managed.
      • Не злоупотребляй: 2–3 условных предложения на эссе достаточно.

      Speaking

      • Part 3 «What would happen if…?» → отвечай Second conditional: If everyone worked from home, city centres would probably become quieter…
      • Part 1 «What would you do if you had a day off?» — If I had a free day, I'd…
